jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**ABOUT CIM GROUP:**

CIM is a community-focused real estate and infrastructure owner, operator, lender, and developer. Our team of experts works together to identify and create value in real assets, benefiting the communities in which we invest. Back in 1994, our three founders focused on projects in Southern California neighborhoods. Today, we are a diverse team of 900+ employees with projects across the Americas. Our projects have delivered jobs; created comfortable places to live, work, and relax; and provided necessary and sustainable infrastructure. Our focus on enhancing communities is unwavering, and we strive to make an even greater impact in the years to come. Join us and make an impact today!

**POSITION PURPOSE:**

We are seeking an experienced Project Coordinator to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for analyzing business needs, documenting business requirements, writing test cases and creating process flows. The Project Coordinator will assist with project management tasks, such as drafting comprehensive project plans, overseeing budget allocations, and ensuring adherence to timelines.

The ideal candidate is a quick learner who will learn the intricacies of business processes across CIM and understand their impact on strategic projects. This role requires a proactive individual to coordinate the efforts of internal and external team members to deliver projects according to plan.

This role also requires someone who is comfortable switching between business analysis and project management duties, as may be required by project needs. This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Director of PMO and Business Operations.

### **RESPONSIBILITIES:**

Business Analysis:

* Work with business owners and stakeholders to understand their business processes. Identify process improvement opportunities.
* Translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements, process flows and future state requirements. Write and manage test cases that trace back to business requirements.
* Support change management efforts, including training and adoption planning.
* Facilitate end-user testing and ensure deliverables meet quality standards.
* Serve as a liaison between business units and technical teams to ensure alignment and clarity.

General Analytics:

* Data Analysis: Collect, analyze, and interpret data to identify trends, patterns, and insights that inform business decisions. Proactively review data and identify & recommend opportunities.
* Problem-Solving: Apply analytical thinking to solve complex business problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Requirements Gathering: Conduct thorough requirements gathering sessions with stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into actionable project plans.

Documentation:

* Technical Documentation: Develop and maintain thorough project documentation, including project charters, requirements documents, and user manuals.
* Process Documentation: Document business processes and workflows to ensure clarity and consistency across the organization. Helps design, document and maintain system processes as needed.
* Meeting Minutes: Record detailed meeting minutes and action items to ensure accountability and follow-up.
* Reporting: Prepare detailed reports and presentations for stakeholders, summarizing project progress, risks, and recommendations.

### **EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS: (including certification, licenses, etc.)**

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Information Systems Project Management, or a related field.
* Minimum of 2-3 years of experience in business analyst or project management, preferably in investment management, private equity, financial services or consulting. Must have contributed to the execution of multiple projects from inception to implementation.
* Active or pursuing Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or PMI-PBA (Professional in Business Analysis) or similar.
* Familiarity with Waterfall, hybrid & Agile /Scrum methodologies.
* Experience with project management tools such as Jira, Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, Asana, Monday, etc.
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite (incl. Excel (VLOOKUP, pivot tables etc.)) and Visio.
* Experience with AI tools such as Copilot and Claude in a workplace setting.

Preferred qualifications:

* Treasury and Cash: Finance background with working knowledge of treasury and cash processes, such as cash positioning, payments (ACH, wire, and virtual card), bank reconciliation, and payment fraud controls.
* Experience with Yardi or another real estate ERP, or with AP automation and outsourced payment programs.

### **ABOUT YOU:**

* Strong relationship building and influencing skills. Excellent written and verbal communication, along with strong interpersonal skills.
* Proven experience in eliciting business requirements and documentation with minimal supervision.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
* Ability to handle ambiguity and influence others to achieve common goals.

**WHAT CIM OFFERS:**

At CIM, we believe our success stems from our collective efforts, and we are committed to providing well-rounded support and resources for our employees. In addition to a competitive compensation plan, CIM offers a comprehensive benefits program for employees to thrive both inside and outside of work. Eligible employees can enjoy a wide range of benefits, including:

* A variety of Medical, dental, and vision benefit plans
* Health Savings Account with a generous employer contribution
* Company paid life and disability insurance
* 401(k) savings plan, with company match
* Comprehensive paid time off, including: vacation days, 10 designated holidays, sick time, and bereavement leave
* Up to 16 hours of volunteer time off
* Up to 16 weeks of Paid Parental Leave
* Ongoing professional development programs
* Wellness program, including month

jobs.title: Customer Service/Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Us:**  
At 6 Degrees Collective, we are an exciting, fast-growing company committed to making a difference in the Personal Care industry. As we continue to expand, we are looking for an energetic and driven **Customer Service/Project Coordinator** to join our team. This role offers a unique opportunity to grow alongside a rapidly evolving company and play a key role in delivering exceptional service and successful projects. If you’re passionate about customer satisfaction, project management, and career advancement, we want to hear from you!

**Position Overview:**  
As a **Customer Service/Project Coordinator**, you will be the bridge between our clients and our internal teams, ensuring projects run smoothly while delivering an outstanding customer experience. You will manage multiple projects, coordinate resources, and communicate effectively with clients to make sure their needs are met. This role requires strong communication skills, organizational abilities, and a passion for problem-solving. It’s a great opportunity to take ownership of your work and contribute directly to the company’s success.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Client Communication:** Act as the primary point of contact for clients, responding to inquiries, addressing concerns, and providing updates on project progress.
* **Project Coordination:** Oversee the planning and execution of projects, ensuring that timelines, quality standards, and client expectations are met.
* **Team Collaboration:** Work closely with internal teams, including sales, operations, and marketing, to ensure seamless project delivery.
* **Problem-Solving:** Resolve issues as they arise, ensuring customer satisfaction and project success while maintaining a positive relationship with clients.
* **Reporting:** Track project milestones, deadlines, and budgets, providing regular updates to both clients and internal stakeholders.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Identify and implement process improvements to streamline project management and enhance the customer experience.

**Qualifications:**

* **Education:** A **Bachelor’s Degree** is required.
* **Experience:** Previous experience in customer service or project management (1-3 years preferred).
* **Communication Skills:** Excellent verbal and written communication skills in **English**—ability to communicate clearly and effectively with clients and team members.
* **Technical Skills:** Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and project management tools (e.g., Asana, Trello, or similar platforms).
* **Organizational Skills:** Ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize tasks effectively in a fast-paced environment.
* **Problem-Solving:** Strong critical thinking skills with the ability to find solutions quickly and efficiently.
* **Attention to Detail:** High attention to detail to ensure projects meet quality standards and client expectations.

**Why Join Us?**

* **Growth Opportunities:** This role offers excellent opportunities for professional growth and development within a rapidly growing company.
* **Dynamic Environment:** Be part of a fast-paced, innovative team where every day brings new challenges and opportunities.
* **Collaborative Culture:** Join a supportive team where your ideas are valued, and collaboration is key to success.
* **Competitive Compensation:** We offer a competitive salary and benefits package.
* **Impact:** As a key member of our team, your work will directly contribute to the company’s continued growth and success.

**How to Apply:**  
If you're ready to take your career to the next level in a fast-growing company, we'd love to hear from you! Please submit your resume and a cover letter detailing why you’re the perfect fit for this role to HR.recruitment@6degrees.com. We can’t wait to meet you!

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: From $75,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Ability to Relocate:

* Santa Clarita, CA 91355: Relocate before starting work (Required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Marketing Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Alabaster is one of the most exciting and fast-growing companies in faith-based publishing today. Founded in Los Angeles, we create beautiful and compelling Christian products — integrating thoughtful design, theological depth, and cultural relevance to help people engage with faith in meaningful ways.

The Marketing Project Coordinator supports the planning, coordination, and execution of marketing campaigns across the business. This role works cross-functionally with Marketing, Product, Operations, Inventory, Customer Experience, and Wholesale to ensure campaigns are organized, communicated effectively, and executed on time. The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, adaptable, and eager to learn, with strong communication skills and the ability to bring people and projects together in a fast-paced environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Coordinate the planning and execution of product launches and marketing campaigns from pre-launch preparation through post-launch review
* Develop and maintain project timelines, milestones, task assignments, and deliverables to keep campaigns on track
* Coordinate cross-functional teams and stakeholders to ensure clear communication, alignment, and timely execution of campaign activities
* Support product launch preparation, including retail pricing, product listings across sales platforms, inventory timelines, and marketing asset availability
* Coordinate website and product page setup, presale preparation, promotional codes, and backend systems to ensure launch readiness
* Coordinate email and SMS marketing execution, working with relevant team members to ensure campaign deliverables are completed on schedule
* Facilitate communication and collaboration across marketing, content, operations, inventory, customer experience, and wholesale teams
* Participate in marketing syncs, campaign ideation meetings, and post-campaign debriefs to track action items, communicate updates, and support ongoing improvements
* Proactively identify project gaps, potential delays, and execution challenges, working with relevant team members to resolve issues
* Conduct post-launch audits to ensure campaign components are functioning as intended and identify opportunities for improvement
* Build and maintain effective project management systems, workflows, and processes to improve marketing campaign efficiency and team communication

**Requirements**

* Strong organizational and time management skills, with excellent attention to detail
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively across teams and stakeholders
* Proactive and resourceful, with a willingness to take initiative, follow up, and address challenges independently
* Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to understand different working styles and build effective relationships across teams
* Adaptable and comfortable navigating changing priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Eager to learn, receptive to feedback, and motivated to support the success of the broader team
* Ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and competing priorities simultaneously
* Comfortable learning and working with project management tools and platforms

**Bonus Points If You Have**

* Experience in project coordination, event planning, or marketing is a plus, but not required
* Experience working with project management tools and platforms is a plus, but not required

**Benefits**

* The expected salary range for this position is $69,500 to $75,000 per year, depending on experience
* Exceptional health coverage (medical, dental, vision) with 99% of premiums covered by us
* A 401(k) plan with a 3% salary contribution from us, enroll after six months
* Generous paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays
* Enjoy various stipends for work and wellness, and a generous 85% discount on company products
* A collaborative, mission-driven, and growth-oriented work environment
* Opportunity to directly impact the financial strategy of a rapidly growing e-commerce company

jobs.title: ProAV Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Supervision**  
  
Reports to: Technical Product Manager

  

**Come grow with us!**

Working at ViewSonic is a unique opportunity to do rewarding, meaningful, high-visibility work for a global leader in visual technology. At ViewSonic, we are celebrating nearly 4 decades of excellence, carrying on the same entrepreneurial spirit and innovation we’ve had since 1987. Our brand and products are well-known throughout the industry. As a result, we are growing quickly and are looking for energetic, motivated team members to expand our nest.

  

**Your Role and Impact**

The **Pro AV Project Coordinator** serves as ViewSonic's primary facilitator for the successful and timely completion of Pro AV projects, including direct-view LED (dvLED), commercial displays, and custom solutions. From the time an order is received through installation and final close-out, this role helps keep all parties aligned throughout the project lifecycle, including integrators, installers, design engineers, Solutions Engineers, Product Management, and end customers.

The Project Coordinator acts as the primary point of contact for on-site activities, coordinating project details and helping ensure work is completed accurately and on schedule. This role also plays an important part in strategic Pro AV rollouts and custom projects, translating Solutions Engineering designs into complete, competitively priced design packages that support opportunities through the next stages of the sales process.

Beyond day-to-day project execution, the Project Coordinator leads the development of scalable standard operating procedures (SOPs) that strengthen efficiency and consistency across Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product Management, and Operations. In close partnership with Product Management, this role will help drive the continued growth of ViewSonic's Pro AV business by creating repeatable processes that allow the team to manage a growing volume of projects while maintaining quality, consistency, and timely execution.

**Day to Day Responsibilities**

* Plan and manage strategic Pro AV rollouts across Commercial Displays, dvLED, and related product lines, including large-scale and multi-site deployments.
* Manage custom projects from start to finish, including scheduling design calls, assembling complete design packages following Solutions Engineering design completion, and coordinating pricing with Product Management.
* Proactively identify project risks, potential delays, and dependencies, driving resolution before they impact project timelines or delivery.
* Coordinate all dvLED orders once received, including reviewing order details, confirming configurations and required accessories, and tracking orders through delivery.
* Manage project timelines and coordinate installation schedules with integrators, installers, and internal teams, serving as the primary point of contact for on-site activities and ensuring site readiness and successful, on-time completion.
* Coordinate escalated troubleshooting efforts, bringing together Solutions Engineering, Service, Engineering, and Product teams to resolve complex issues quickly and effectively.
* Maintain project schedules, status trackers, and supporting documentation throughout the project lifecycle, including key milestones, installation outcomes, and close-out details, while providing regular updates to Sales, Product Management, customers, and other key stakeholders.
* Lead the development and continuous improvement of scalable SOPs for key Pro AV workflows, including order intake, installation scheduling, troubleshooting escalation, design packages, and project close-out, to improve efficiency and consistency across teams.
* Support industry trade shows, conferences, and events, such as InfoComm, as needed.

**Your Profile**

**Required Qualifications**

* Associate degree or higher in Business Administration, Project Management, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
* 2+ years of experience coordinating projects in the Pro AV market
* Experience working with AV integrators, design engineers, project managers, and installers
* Working knowledge of project management principles, scheduling, and resource coordination
* Familiarity with Pro AV systems, including dvLED, commercial displays, and signal distribution
* Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines at once in a fast-paced environment
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
* Strong communication, customer service, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work across internal teams and external partners
* Proficiency with MS Office products (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

**Preferred Qualifications**

* CTS (Certified Technology Specialist) certification
* Manufacturer certifications such as Extron, Q-SYS, or other Pro AV manufacturer certifications
* Experience with dvLED installation projects, including familiarity with ViewSonic, Samsung, LG, Planar, Absen, Daktronics, or similar platforms
* Prior experience working for a display or AV manufacturer or AV integrator
* Familiar with project management tools
* Ability to read architectural, electrical, and AV design drawings

**What’s in it for you:**

* Medical, Dental and Vision insurance options
* 401k with company match
* Paid Time Off
* Company provided equipment

**Work Environment & Requirements**

* **Office Presence**: Hybrid: 3 days in office, 2 days local off-site
* **Environment**: Primarily normal office conditions, with occasional visits to customer and installation sites.
* **Physical Effort**: Primarily sedentary work. Must be able to lift to 25 lbs. unassisted.
* **Hazards**: Minimal; occasional site visits may involve active construction or installation environments. Appropriate safety equipment will be provided.
* **Travel:** Up to 10%, including occasional site visits, project kickoffs, and industry trade shows

jobs.title: Program Specialist
jobs.description:
At **Wayfinder Family Services**, we understand the unique challenges facing some of our state’s most vulnerable children, youth and adults. Those with disabilities, those without a home of their own, those who have been abused and many, many more. We answer the call for them. We believe in the amazing potential in, and for, each and every one of them. And, together, we find a way to turn that potential into reality.

**Role Summary:**

The primary focus of the **Program Specialist** is to provide administrative, operational, and customer service support for the Relative Home Assessment Services (RHAS) Program. This position serves as a key point of contact for relative and non-relative extended family member (NREFM) caregivers, county partners, social workers, and agency staff throughout the assessment and approval process. The Program Specialist is responsible for ensuring timely processing of referrals, maintaining accurate records, coordinating appointments and trainings, tracking regulatory timelines, and supporting program staff in achieving compliance with applicable regulations, contractual requirements, and agency standards.

The hourly wage range for this role is $25.00 - $26.00.

**This position is eligible for a a $1,000 sign-on bonus.**

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Track Household Purchase Records submissions and ensure all required documentation is submitted and processed within the contractual timeframe.
* Track satisfaction surveys with RHAS families.
* Ensure integrity of clients’ records through accurate filing and updating of chart materials and ensure all centralized files and file cabinets are secured during business hours.
* Assist in the coordination, organization, and logistical support of ongoing groups and program activities such as arranging meeting space, confirming attendance, and providing additional support as needed.
* Maintain and distribute agency rosters and logs.
* Sort and file all correspondence, reports, records, documents, or other materials, search files to retrieve information as requested.
* Provide clerical/ reception/ office administrative duties. Greet visitors and take telephone calls, refer visitors and callers to appropriate staff or offices.
* Receive, open, date-stamps, and route mail. Addresses and processes all outgoing mail.
* Track, monitor, and document the completion of all required Resource Family Approval (RFA) training modules as part of the initial approval process, ensuring compliance with applicable ongoing training requirements and established deadlines.
* Perform other duties as may become necessary or as directed.

**Education and Experience:**

* High school diploma or higher and 4 years' experience in office and customer service.
* Experience in child welfare, foster care, social services, family services, behavioral health, or nonprofit programs preferred.
* Experience coordinating services, managing databases, and maintaining confidential records preferred.
* Experience working with relative caregivers, resource families, or child welfare programs is highly desirable.
* Bilingual (Spanish), required.
* Valid California Driver’s License with a minimum of three (3) years of good driving history and must be approved by the agency’s insurance carrier to drive agency vehicles.

**Benefits**: Wayfinder is committed to providing our employees with a benefits program that is both comprehensive and competitive which includes:

* Paid Time Off: Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) policy, 11 paid holidays, plus five winter holidays
* Medical, dental, vision, life, and long-term disability insurance
* 401(k) retirement plan with employer match up to 4%
* Employee referral program: Encourage your colleagues to join us
* Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) eligible
* Flexible spending account (FSA) plans
* Eligibility and other benefits are outlined in plan documents

***Wayfinder Family Services is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We support a drug-free workplace and conduct pre-employment background and drug screenings.***

jobs.description:
Gaining Early Awareness and Readiness for Undergraduate Programs (GEAR UP) strives to increase the number of underrepresented students from low-income backgrounds who enter and succeed in postsecondary education.

Under the supervision of the GEAR UP Director, the Program Coordinator will lead in the development, coordination, implementation, documentation, and evaluation of comprehensive services and activities for program participants to meet GEAR UP Grant Objectives. The Program Coordinator serves as a primary liaison between the Project Director and designated partner school site(s), overseeing academic advising, tutoring, college and career readiness, student and family engagement, and enrichment opportunities. The position works collaboratively with school districts, administrators, participant families, teachers, university partners, community organizations, and GEAR UP staff to advance program objectives and ensure compliance with grant requirements.

This position will require travel between the CSUF campus, designated school sites, and other partner locations. Some early morning, evening, weekend, and overnight work will be required.

* *Please be aware that funding for this position is awarded through a Grant/Contract over a specified period. Employment for this position beyond current Grant/Contract funding is contingent upon continued funding.*

**Program Planning and Implementation:**

* Lead the planning, development, coordination, implementation, and evaluation of GEAR UP programs and activities, including workshops, field trips, campus tours, GEAR UP Academies, special events, and enrichment opportunities for students and families.
* Manage an assigned participant caseload ranging from 200 to 500 program participants and provide timely advising to support participants’ academic progress, college and career exploration, and postsecondary goals.

**Program Participant Advising and Academic Support:**

* Provide individual and group advising to students on academic progress, postsecondary planning, college and career exploration, college and career selection, applications, scholarships, and financial aid.
* Coordinate tutoring, mentoring, referrals, parent/guardian advisement, and other academic support services as needed.

**Program Participant Success Planning:**

* Develop, monitor, and update Individual Academic/Success Plans in collaboration with students, parents/guardians, and/or school personnel.

**School and Community Partnerships:**

* Serve as a liaison between the Project Director and designated school sites.
* Develop and maintain collaborative relationships with school administrators, teachers, counselors, district personnel, university partners, community organizations, parents/guardians, and other stakeholders to support program objectives.

**Staff Supervision and Development:**

* Recruit, train, supervise, mentor, and schedule GEAR UP staff, student ambassadors, graduate assistants, mentors, and other assigned personnel.
* Support staff development, consistent service delivery, and compliance with program policies and procedures.
* Track and report staff payroll and effort certifications as assigned.

**Program Documentation and Data Management:**

* Maintain organized, accurate, and confidential participant records, program files, attendance, participation, demographic data, service documentation, curriculum, and other records using established systems and in accordance with grant requirements and program policies.

**Budget and Grant Compliance:**

* Assist in planning and reviewing budget allocations and expenditures for staffing, materials, events, and program initiatives.
* Oversee the collection, valuation, documentation, and reporting of in-kind cost-match contributions to support compliance with U.S. Department of Education grant requirements.

**Program Evaluation and Reporting:**

* Monitor program implementation and progress toward grant objectives and established benchmarks.
* Assist with preparing annual performance reports, evaluations, assessments, and periodic updates for internal use, CSUF, the U.S. Department of Education, and other project stakeholders.
* Maintain accurate and secure program records, protect confidential student information, and follow established policies and procedures when accessing, storing, and sharing data.

* Coordinate participant recruitment, retention, and family engagement efforts to increase participation in GEAR UP services.
* Develop and implement outreach strategies to raise awareness of program opportunities and foster a college-going culture.

**Communications and Program Promotion:**

* Assist in developing and distributing GEAR UP websites, social media content, brochures, flyers, posters, presentations, and other informational materials to increase program visibility across CSUF, partner schools, and community audiences.

**Representation and Collaboration:**

* Represent GEAR UP and CSUF at school sites, community events, meetings, trainings, and other professional settings.

jobs.title: Marketing & Communications Coordinator
jobs.description:
Safe Parking LA provides safe overnight parking to facilitate stability and housing in Los Angeles County for individuals living in their vehicles, and advocates for fair and equitable treatment and resources for the unhoused.

**Job Title:** Marketing & Communications Coordinator

**Location:** Los Angeles, CA / Hybrid

**FLSA Status:** Full-time, Non-Exempt

**Department:** Development

**Reports to:** Development Manager

**Salary/ Compensation**: $28-30/hr.

**Effective:** 11/13/2026

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Marketing & Communications Coordinator supports Safe Parking LA’s mission by producing clear, timely, and mission-aligned communications across digital, print, email, social media, website, donor-facing, and public-facing channels. This role is responsible for coordinating and executing day-to-day communications work while taking ownership of specific communications and marketing projects, such as impact reports, newsletters, social media initiatives, and marketing campaigns. This position manages timelines, tracks deliverables, and ensures projects move forward in alignment with department priorities.

Serves as the intake point for media inquiries: acknowledges receipt, gathers details, and routes each one to the Executive Director or Director of Development, who serve as spokesperson.

This position is well-suited for a strong writer and content producer who can manage multiple projects, stay organized, and take ownership of assigned communications initiatives while supporting fundraising, community engagement, and organizational visibility.

**WHAT YOUR DAYS CONSIST OF**

**Content Production and Digital Communications (35%)**

* Draft, edit, schedule, and publish content across social media, email, website, and other digital platforms.
* Maintain and update website content to ensure accuracy and relevance.
* Support email marketing production, including formatting, list coordination, testing, scheduling, and basic performance tracking.
* Create and adapt content for different audiences, including donors, volunteers, community partners, and the general public.
* Maintain the communications calendar and coordinate timelines to ensure content is reviewed and published on schedule.
* Track basic engagement metrics and share insights with the Development Manager.

**Project Coordination and Initiative Ownership (35%)**

* Take ownership of assigned communications and marketing projects.
* Coordinate project timelines, tasks, and deliverables to ensure work is completed on schedule within scope and budget.
* Track progress across projects and follow up with internal contributors as needed.
* Ensure materials are reviewed, approved, and finalized before publication.
* Identify potential delays or gaps and communicate proactively with the Development Manager.
* Maintain organized project files, templates, and documentation for recurring communications efforts.

**Design, Storytelling, and Brand Consistency (20%)**

* Design graphics and materials for digital and print use, including social media assets, flyers, donor materials, and event collateral.
* Maintain visual and messaging consistency across all communications in adherence to brand identity and guidelines.
* Gather and organize photos, stories, testimonials, and other content assets in coordination with program and development staff.
* Support development of donor-facing materials such as appeals, stewardship pieces, reports, and presentations.
* Ensure all communications embody ethical storytelling and reflect participant dignity, accuracy, and SPLA’s mission and values.

**Media and Public Inquiry Coordination (10%)**

* Monitor and respond to incoming media inquiries as the first point of contact, acknowledging receipt, and gathering key details.
* Screen inquiries for relevance and urgency and escalate to appropriate leadership for response.
* Coordinate approved media engagements, including scheduling, logistics, and adherence to protocols.
* Maintain records of media inquiries and outcomes.
* Monitor public-facing comments and escalate sensitive or high-risk issues.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

* Communications projects are completed on time and meet established expectations.
* Assigned campaigns, newsletters, and initiatives are well-coordinated and executed with minimal oversight.
* Communications are accurate, timely, and aligned with organizational priorities.
* Website, email, and social media content are current, consistent, and professionally executed.
* Campaign and event communications support fundraising and engagement goals.
* Media inquiries are handled promptly and escalated appropriately.
* Content assets and project materials are organized and accessible.
* Communications contribute to increased visibility, engagement, and donor support.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* At least two years of experience in marketing, communications, digital media, or a related field.
* Strong writing, editing, and proofreading skills.
* Experience with social media, email marketing, website updates, and content scheduling.
* Basic graphic design skills and experience creating digital or print materials.
* Familiarity with tools such as Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, email marketing platforms, website CMS, and social media platforms.
* Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
* Ability to take ownership of assigned projects and follow through to completion.
* Ability to exercise sound judgment and escalate sensitive issues appropriately.
* Ability to work independently while following established processes.
* Experience with nonprofit or mission-driven communications preferred.
* Ability to travel to program sites and events in Los Angeles County (mileage reimbursed under SPLA policy).
* Ability to work on occasional evenings and weekends.
* Commitment to Safe Parking LA’s mission and values.

jobs.title: Administrative Coordinator II
jobs.description:
**Job Summary:**

  
Helps facilitate information maintenance and distribution by learning and drafting routine and standard presentations, correspondence, and reports. Organizes workflow by following detailed instructions in the identification and assistance of the resolution of routine requests from front-line teams and department managers on an ad-hoc basis. Assists with event coordination by beginning to coordinate and calendar meetings for directors and their direct teams, with guidance from senior colleagues. Assists with event execution by arranging small-scale events with detailed instructions and monitoring from senior colleagues. Learns to execute data maintenance and management by developing basic knowledge of department data and documentation retention policies.

**Essential Responsibilities:**

  
  

  
* Works with others within work team to obtain and share basic information. Listens and addresses performance feedback; provides feedback to team members. Learns new relevant knowledge and skills; acknowledges strengths and weaknesses based on career goals and takes action to leverage / improve them. Adapts to change, challenges, and feedback with moderate guidance. Responds to the needs of others to support completion of routine work tasks.
  
* Follows detailed, daily instructions to complete routine tasks with moderate supervision. Collaborates with others within ones team to address routine and some non-routine task issues; communicates status and escalates more complex issues. Adheres to established priorities, deadlines, and expectations. Identifies and speaks up for improvement opportunities within ones team.
  
* Helps facilitate information dissemination by: learning and drafting routine and standard presentations, handouts, reports/spreadsheets, graphics, status reports, resource management reports, and other deliverables based on a working knowledge of business practices/process, with detailed direction from senior colleagues with minimal interpretation; writing correspondence (e.g., letters, reports, confidential documents) to staff and managers, with moderate guidance from senior colleagues; and following broad guidance labeling, sorting, and maintaining the integrity of department files.

jobs.description:
**Karman Industries**

Karman Industries is a Torrance-based thermal technology company building the backbone for giga-scale AI infrastructure. Founded by a team from SpaceX, Rocket Lab, and GE, Karman is moving beyond legacy cooling with the launch of the **HPU (Heat Processing Unit)**—a new category of thermal architecture designed for the 100kW+ rack era.

The HPU shrinks the exterior mechanical yard by up to 80% while reducing peak energy consumption by 10%+. Unlike traditional systems, the Karman HPU provides zero-water (WUE 0) cooling that ensures high-TDP GPUs and HBM4 memory stay at optimal thermal setpoints without throttling.

Founded in 2024, we’re a fast-growing team of passionate professionals dedicated to making a tangible impact on the future of humanity. We design, build, and test real hardware, and we lead with ownership: you’ll own your work from concept to hardware and help shape how we scale. Our values are Ownership, Performance Excellence, Radical Transparency, and Customer-Centricity.

Join us in our mission to transform the industry and contribute to a more sustainable world.

**Recruiting Coordinator (Temp-to-Hire)**

Karman Industries is seeking a Recruiting Coordinator to keep our hiring process moving quickly and give every candidate a great experience during a period of rapid growth. Interviews, onsites, and offers need to run smoothly, and this role is the engine behind that. You will work closely with our recruiters, hiring managers, and HR to make sure candidates are scheduled, informed, and cared for from first screen to offer.

This is a temp-to-hire role with real exposure to the full recruiting process, designed for someone who aspires to become a recruiter. You will own the logistics that let recruiters spend their time sourcing and closing, and you will learn the work alongside them, from intake calls to debriefs to offers. For the right person, there is a path to a full-time role with Karman. We value clarity, speed, accountability, and first-principles thinking.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Schedule different types of interviews in Ashby, coordinating calendars across candidates, managers, and interview panels.
* Build onsite agendas, including panel interviews, technical screens, and the team meet, tour, and technical test used for technician and hourly roles.
* Be a responsive, friendly point of contact for candidates, answering questions and sending clear prep information before each interview.
* Send timely candidate communications, including scheduling emails and decline emails from approved templates..
* Support job postings, including updating job descriptions and confirming that postings are live and consistent.
* Gain hands-on recruiting experience by sitting in on intake calls and debriefs, supporting sourcing and candidate outreach, and shadowing recruiter screens.
* Help organize recruiting events and candidate gatherings, and support recruiters and hiring managers with ad hoc tasks as our hiring plan grows.

**Basic Requirements**

* 1+ years of experience in recruiting coordination, scheduling, administrative, or similar role, preferably in a fast-paced environment.
* A clear interest in building a career in recruiting and a desire to learn the full process.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage many moving parts and shifting priorities.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a warm and professional tone.
* Proficiency with calendar and scheduling tools, video conferencing, and Microsoft Office
* Highly self-motivated and reliable, able to get up to speed quickly with minimal structure.
* Ability to work on-site in Torrance.

**Preferred Requirements**

* Experience with Ashby or another applicant tracking system.
* Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter or other sourcing tools.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Communications, Human Resources, or a related field.

If you are a **natural salesperson who loves real estate, luxury homes, interiors, and design**, this is an opportunity to turn those interests into a rewarding career with one of Southern California’s leading home-staging companies.

ABOUT ELITE HOME STAGING

Elite Home Staging is the **third-largest home-staging company in Southern California**, with more than **200 homes across the Los Angeles market**. We specialize in beautifully designed staging for luxury properties and work closely with real estate agents, brokers, developers, builders, and homeowners to help properties make a powerful first impression and sell successfully.

THE ROLE

We are looking for an energetic **Sales Representative / Business Development professional** whose primary responsibility will be to **generate new clients and grow Elite Home Staging's business**.

This is a highly relationship-driven sales position. You will be responsible for building a strong network within the real estate community, identifying potential clients, developing relationships, following up consistently, and converting opportunities into new staging business.

You will have the opportunity to work directly with **top-producing real estate agents, luxury brokers, developers, and other industry professionals** throughout Southern California.

* Regularly visit real estate offices and meet with agents to introduce Elite Home Staging
* Identify high-value sales opportunities and turn prospects into long-term clients
* Follow up with leads consistently and strategically

* Maintain ongoing relationships with existing clients while continuously pursuing new business

DESIGN INTEREST IS A MAJOR PLUS

You **do not need to be an interior designer**, but you should have a genuine interest in **interior design, furniture, architecture, luxury homes, and current design trends**.

The ideal candidate understands that selling staging is about more than selling furniture—it is about helping agents and homeowners **position a property, create an emotional connection with buyers, and maximize the property's presentation.**

Your design eye will help you speak confidently with clients and understand what makes a home marketable.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for someone who is:

* Comfortable with cold calling and prospecting

Experience in **real estate, home staging, interior design, furniture, luxury sales, hospitality, recruiting, or business development** is a plus.

However, **we are more interested in your sales ability, personality, work ethic, and drive than a specific background.**

If you are someone who can walk into a real estate office, confidently introduce yourself, start a conversation with an agent, build a relationship, and ultimately turn that relationship into business—you may be exactly who we're looking for.

COMPENSATION & OPPORTUNITY

This position offers a **competitive compensation structure with commission and significant earning potential based on sales performance.**

The opportunity is ideal for someone who wants their income to reflect their effort and success.

WHY ELITE HOME STAGING?

* Work with a recognized leader in Southern California's home-staging industry
* Build relationships with **high-producing real estate professionals**
* Work around luxury homes and beautiful interiors
* Opportunity for significant commission and sales growth
* Be part of a creative, fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment

* Grow with an established and expanding company

READY TO MAKE AN IMPACT?

If you are **a salesperson at heart, love design and real estate, and are hungry to build a book of business**, we want to hear from you.

**Elite Home Staging is looking for someone who doesn't wait for business to come to them—they go out and create it.**

jobs.description:
**About the Company**

Nitrogen Express is a family-owned industrial and specialty gas distribution business. We supply businesses that need gases and related products to keep their operations running. We earn revenue by selling and delivering products and by keeping customers invoiced, collected, and serviced reliably.

**About the Position**

We need one accountable, in-office owner for the company’s day-to-day financial administration and office operating rhythm. The work is important to cash flow, vendor relationships, customer experience, and good decision-making. We want to replace fragmented processes with reliable systems—not just fill a desk.

This is a high-visibility seat in a stable, family-owned business where a capable person can make a real difference. The person will not be stuck doing one narrow transaction all day. They will own meaningful financial workflows, work directly with the owner, improve how the business operates, and build systems that matter. It is an excellent opportunity for someone who is tired of being buried in a large company or limited to a narrow AP/AR silo and wants broader responsibility.

**Responsibilities**

This person should own the day-to-day financial workflows for a small operating business, with appropriate owner review and approval on major decisions and payments.

* Maintain clean, timely QuickBooks Online records and supporting documentation.
* Drive invoicing promptly and accurately; identify missing information before it creates a billing delay.
* Own the accounts-receivable rhythm: aging review, professional customer follow-up, notes, escalation, and collections follow-through.
* Organize accounts payable: receive and code bills, maintain vendor files, prepare a clear weekly payables list, and make sure nothing important is missed. Owner approval remains required for payments.
* Support bank and credit-card reconciliations, month-end readiness, and clear financial reporting for the owner and outside accounting support.
* Create, document, and maintain practical SOPs for invoicing, collections, payables, customer account setup, and file management.
* Use Excel, QuickBooks, and secure AI-enabled tools thoughtfully to reduce manual work, catch errors, create follow-up drafts, improve reporting, and make processes more reliable.
* Serve as a dependable, professional in-office point of contact for customers, vendors, and the team.

**First 30 / 60 / 90 days**

* Learn the business, customer/payment cycles, QuickBooks structure, vendors, and current workflow.
* Take control of the AR aging and open-payables visibility.
* Identify immediate invoicing, collections, and file-organization gaps.
* Establish a weekly owner-facing cash, receivables, and payables rhythm.

* Implement a consistent invoice-to-collection process and documented collection cadence.
* Clean up vendor, customer, and supporting-document workflows.
* Create clear SOPs for the highest-risk recurring tasks.
* Present the first practical automation / process-improvement recommendations.

* Deliver reliable recurring reporting to the owner.
* Show improved visibility into AR aging, invoicing status, and upcoming payables.
* Complete at least two meaningful workflow improvements that reduce manual rework or missed follow-up.
* Deliver a prioritized next-step plan for stronger controls, reporting, and sensible use of AI.

**What success looks like**

* Success is not just “the books are entered.” The right person makes the financial side of the business feel organized, current, and visible. Invoices go out on time, collections are handled professionally and consistently, vendor obligations are clear, records are easy to find, and the owner can see what needs attention without chasing information.

Qualifications

* At least 3 years of relevant hands-on accounting/finance-office experience.
* Recent hands-on experience with QuickBooks and the end-to-end cycle of invoicing, AR/collections, AP, vendor bills, and financial organization—not only one narrow task in a large department.
* QuickBooks Online, Excel, bank/credit-card reconciliation, billing, receivables, collections, payables, and basic reporting.
* Experience in a small owner-led B2B business such as distribution, industrial supply, logistics, field service, construction supply, equipment rental/repair, manufacturing support, or a similar operational environment.
* A practical, privacy-conscious use of AI and automation. The candidate should be able to name specific workflows improved with AI or automation and explain how they protected customer and financial information.
* Comfortable making courteous but firm collections calls and documenting commitments.
* A demonstrated record of identifying a problem, creating a usable process, following through, and communicating clearly with an owner, customers, vendors, and teammates.
* The person must want to work in the office five days per week and have a realistic commute.

No CPA or bachelor’s degree is required if the person can demonstrate the actual skills, judgment, and ownership required for the job. A bookkeeping or QuickBooks certification is a plus, not a substitute for proven work.

Compensation and Benefits

* $52,000–$58,000, depending on proven ownership of the full workflow and the ability to improve systems.

At Hamilton Families, our mission is to end family homelessness in the San Francisco Bay Area. Since 1985, we have been meeting the most urgent needs of unhoused families in our community. Our programs specialize in preventing family homelessness when possible, providing shelter and transitional housing to families in times of need, supporting the wellbeing and academic achievement of children who experience homelessness, and quickly returning families to safe and stable housing throughout the Greater Bay Area. At Hamilton Families, we believe the San Francisco Bay Area is at its best when people from all backgrounds can start a life here, raise a family here, and thrive here. We envision a Bay Area where housing is accessible and affordable, where homelessness is rare, brief, and nonrecurring, and where all people and families have a safe and stable place to live. We foster an inclusive environment where diverse perspectives are valued and contribute to our collective success. Our commitment to inclusivity ensures every team member feels respected, supported, and empowered to thrive.

jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Mancini's Sleepworld**
------------------------------

Mancini's Sleepworld is Northern California's hometown mattress retailer, with 60+ showrooms across the Bay Area, Sacramento, the Central Valley, and the Central Coast. We're family-rooted, locally known, and growing fast, including welcoming Christian's Mattress Xpress showrooms to the family. Our marketing team runs everything from broadcast, streaming, and outdoor to search, social, and in-store promotions, and we're building a smarter, more content-driven marketing organization to support the next phase of growth.

**The role**
------------

**Marketing** at Mancini's moves fast: a new promotion every few weeks, TV and radio across five markets, new showrooms opening, and dozens of partners to keep in sync. The Marketing Coordinator is the person who makes sure it all gets where it needs to go, on time and correct.

You'll keep our promotional calendar running, make sure 60+ showrooms have the right materials for every sale event, get our TV and radio spots to stations with the right instructions, and keep projects moving between marketing, sales, and the rest of the business.

**Duties & Responsibilities**

*Promotions & store support*

* Serve as the central ordering point for store point-of-purchase (POP) materials, including window signs, A-frames, table tents, hanging signs, SEG frames, feather flags, and partner displays, working with print vendors from order through delivery.
* Make sure every showroom has the right promotional materials in place before each sale event, on deadline.
* Keep the promotional calendar up to date and run the checklist for each sale event: signage, pricing collateral, store communication, and launch timing.
* Write and send marketing communications to store teams so every showroom knows what is running, when, and how to talk about it.
* Support new store openings, store transitions, and rebrands, including grand opening kits, signage, and local events.
* Coordinate promotional updates to the website and email with the e-commerce team so every channel matches the current offer.

*TV & radio trafficking*

* Traffic TV, streaming, and radio spots to stations and partners: traffic instructions, rotations, Ad-ID/ISCI codes, and delivery deadlines.
* Update trafficking instructions quickly when promotions change, so the right message is on air for every sale weekend.
* Confirm receipt and on-air start with stations, catch and fix errors, and keep a clean spot library and rotation log by market and promotion.

*Events & community*

* Plan and coordinate community activations and sponsorships, such as high school sports events, including materials, giveaways, staffing, and logistics.
* Support company and partner events, including internal events, vendor events, and sports partnership activations.

*Project coordination & marketing operations*

* Keep account access, documentation, and naming conventions organized so history and assets are easy to find.
* Track spend against budget and pacing, including vendor co-op funds and the documentation needed for reimbursement.
* Work directly with Google and Meta account reps.

**Qualifications**

*Required*

* 1–3 years of experience in marketing coordination, retail marketing, agency account coordination, or broadcast traffic.
* Exceptionally organized and detail-oriented; you catch the wrong date, code, or price before it goes out.
* Able to manage many deadlines at once and follow up until work is done.
* Clear, friendly communicator in writing and in person with store teams, vendors, and agencies.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office and Excel/Google Sheets; experience with a project management tool such as Monday.com, Asana, or Trello.
* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

*Preferred*

* Experience trafficking TV or radio spots, or working at a station, agency, or media company.
* Multi-location retail or home furnishings experience.
* Experience with vendor co-op advertising programs.
* Basic Canva or Adobe skills for quick resizes and store communications.
* Bilingual English/Spanish.

**How success is measured**
---------------------------

**Timeframe**

**What success looks like**

First 30 days

Trafficking and promo calendar handed off with no missed spots or late store materials; knows key contacts at stations, agencies, print vendors, and stores.

60 days

Running the full checklist for a sale event; POP ordering, trafficking log, and spot library up to date; Monday.com boards current.

90 days

Running promotions and trafficking independently; co-op documentation and invoice tracking current; first process improvement proposed.

*Ongoing KPIs: on-time spot delivery and zero trafficking errors, on-time store materials for each event, project timelines met, co-op claims submitted on time, and internal partner satisfaction.*

**Work Environment**

In office at our Livermore corporate office Monday through Thursday; remote on Fridays. Occasional travel to our showrooms as needed.

* Establish and maintain strong relationships and contacts in assigned accounts

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About the job**
-----------------

**Cuttable exists because creativity shouldn’t be what slows marketing teams down.**

The world’s biggest advertising platforms demand more ads than most teams can produce. But production is still slow, expensive and built for a different era. Briefs pile up. Creative teams burn out. Marketers can’t keep up.

Cuttable fixes that.

We’re an AI Creative Production System that helps ecommerce brands create, test and launch ads across Meta, TikTok and Google at the volume the platforms actually reward.

More than 300 brands across North America and Asia Pacific already use Cuttable. We’re backed by Square Peg, Rampersand and AirTree, following one of the largest seed rounds in Australian tech history. Offices in Melbourne and New York.

Our CEO and co-founder, Sam Kroonenburg, has built and scaled a global technology company before. Now we’re doing it again.

**Join us and help make good ads, instantly.**

### **The role**

**Pay range: $101,000 – $151,000 USD per year** — the range we reasonably expect to pay for this role at hire.

As Cuttable scales its US customer base, our customers need someone who owns their success long after onboarding. As a Customer Success Manager, you’ll own retention, adoption and expansion across a book of US customers from day 90 onward, including every renewal in that book. You’ll be the trusted advisor customers call for ideas, not just support, and you’ll treat retention and growth as your number, acting independently and never waiting for permission to save or grow an account.

You’ll report to the Customer Success Director and partner day to day with Implementation, Sales, Product and Support. This role is based in San Francisco, in the office at least 2 days per week (hybrid).

**What you’ll own**

* Retention, adoption and expansion across a book of US customers from day 90 onward, including every renewal.
* The customer relationship after the day-90 handover from Implementation.
* Account health across your book: using usage, health and engagement data to spot at-risk renewals early and act before they land.
* Your number: hitting or beating your renewal and expansion quota once it is set in Q1 2027.

**What you’ll drive**

* Product adoption and expansion (more brands, more users, bigger plans and more of customers’ spend on Cuttable creative) by tying Cuttable to the numbers they care about, like ROAS and CPA.
* Expansion conversations that lead with value, not a pitch, starting from the customer’s goals and results.
* Business reviews and success plans that make the value obvious to decision-makers at every level, from paid social leads to CMOs.
* Customer advocacy: referrals, case studies and champions inside customer teams.
* Smart prioritisation, so multi-brand teams and fast-moving single brands each get the attention that matches what’s at stake.
* Improvements to our renewal and expansion playbook, contributing what’s working in your book as we build the motion in the US.

**Who you’ll support**

* Implementation Managers, by agreeing a clean day-90 handover so customers never feel the change of owner.
* Account Executives, by flagging expansion opportunities and sharing account context ahead of commercial conversations.
* Product, by sharing customer feedback, feature requests and patterns you see across your book.
* Newer team members, through informal mentoring, coaching and empathetic feedback.
* The Customer Success Director, with input on how CSM quotas and variable comp should be measured.

**What success looks like at six months**

* Customers are using more of Cuttable (more brands, more users, more of their spend on Cuttable creative) because you tied it to the numbers they care about, like ROAS and CPA.
* Revenue across your book is growing, and you saw at-risk renewals coming well before they landed.
* Customers call you for advice, not just support. You bring ideas before they ask and do what you say you’ll do.
* Your time matches what’s at stake: multi-brand teams and fast-moving single brands each get the attention they need.
* Your best customers are your best pipeline, referring peers, joining case studies and championing Cuttable inside their own teams.
* You’re on track to hit or exceed your quota from Q1 2027, and you’ve contributed to a renewal and expansion playbook the team uses.

### **Who we look for**

We hire for values as much as experience, because mindset carries you through the parts no job description can predict. Here’s what that looks like day to day at Cuttable:

* **Be Brave & Own It**: you take smart risks and you own what happens next, good or bad. You own the outcome, not just the intention.
* **Create Customer Magic**: you listen hard enough to get to what customers actually need, not just what they said.
* **Say It (With Care)**: You say the honest thing, directly, and with genuine care for the person hearing it.
* **Progress Beats Perfection**: you’d rather ship, learn, and improve than sit on something waiting for it to be flawless.
* **Work Hard, Laugh Often**: you take the work seriously. Never yourself.

We believe you’ll succeed in this role if you have:

* Demonstrated experience as a Customer Success Manager, Account Manager or Account Executive in B2B SaaS, with a track record of growing revenue through renewals, expansion and product adoption, and of hitting or beating your number.
* Experience managing a mix of account sizes, from fast-moving brands to multi-stakeholder teams, and the ability to build trust with decision-makers at every level, from paid social leads to CMOs.
* Strong storytelling: business reviews and success plans that make the value obvious.
* A data-driven way of running your book. Usage, health and engagement tell you where to focus, and you know when to pull in peers or the Customer Success Director for help.
* Comfort using tools like HubSpot, Intercom (or similar), Notion, Loom and Slack.

jobs.title: Content Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**Content-Marketer-San-Francisco**
----------------------------------

**About the job**
-----------------

**Cuttable exists because creativity shouldn’t be what slows marketing teams down.**

The world’s biggest advertising platforms demand more ads than most teams can produce. But production is still slow, expensive and built for a different era. Briefs pile up. Creative teams burn out. Marketers can’t keep up.

Cuttable fixes that.

We’re an AI Creative Production System that helps ecommerce brands create, test and launch ads across Meta, TikTok and Google at the volume the platforms actually reward.

More than 300 brands across North America and Asia Pacific already use Cuttable. We’re backed by Square Peg, Rampersand and AirTree, following one of the largest seed rounds in Australian tech history. Offices in Melbourne and New York.

Our CEO and co-founder, Sam Kroonenburg, has built and scaled a global technology company before. Now we’re doing it again.

**Join us and help make good ads, instantly.**

### **The role**

**Pay range: $95,000 – $125,000 USD per year** **— the range we reasonably expect to pay for this role at hire. Equity is included in every offer.**

Our buyers are performance marketers, creative strategists and ecommerce founders who spend their days on LinkedIn, X and YouTube learning from people who make good ads. We want them to know Cuttable before they ever see a sales deck.

We’re looking for someone who knows what interesting looks like, and makes a lot of it. You don’t need a long CV. You need taste, speed, and to be comfortable picking up a phone and hitting record. You’ll make content yourself, help our founders show up online, and be our person on the ground at US events. You’ll work alongside our new Senior Product Marketing Manager in San Francisco, who owns strategy and positioning, so you can spend your time making things.

**What you’ll do**

* **Make short-form video, a lot of it.** Product walkthroughs, quick takes on what’s working in Meta ads, before-and-afters, event clips. You’ll be on camera often and get better every week.
* **Run founder content.** Get ideas out of our founders, run recording sessions, edit, and post on LinkedIn and X in a voice that sounds like them, not like marketing.
* **Write.** LinkedIn posts, scripts, newsletter pieces and launch copy.
* **Bring launches to life.** When we ship something, you’ll make the content that shows it working, built with the Senior PMM.
* **Be our person at US events.** We do a handful a year, like trade show booths and our own dinners. You’ll help run them with a freelance producer and turn every one into a week of content.
* **Work with creators and editors.** Brief our editor, find creators our buyers already follow, and get collaborations live.

**What a normal week looks like**

8–10 founder posts shipped, 2–3 short videos of your own, and some writing. You’ll make plenty of it in Cuttable itself and use AI tools to turn one recording into a week of posts. Some things will flop. That’s fine. Most good content does after a few misses.

**Working here, honestly**

* **Your manager is in Melbourne.** Your overlap is your afternoon, roughly 2:00pm to 6:00pm. Your mornings are yours, which is great for filming and editing.
* **You’ll learn fast.** You’ll work directly with founders, a senior product marketer next to you, and a product that changes every week.
* **Your own channel is welcome.** We’ll agree in writing up front what’s yours and what’s Cuttable’s.
* **You’ll have a budget** for an editor, gear and freelance help for events.

**What success looks like**

Within 90 days:

* Founder content ships every week without anyone chasing it.
* You’re on camera for Cuttable regularly, and people in our world are starting to recognise you.
* You’ve run content at your first US event.

Within 12 months:

* Cuttable and its founders are known voices on Meta creative among the people we sell to.
* Prospects tell sales they found us through our content, and we can see it on the demo form.

**This won’t be the right role if you**

* Don’t want to be on camera.
* Prefer polishing one thing for a month to shipping something every day.
* Need detailed briefs before you start.

### **Who we look for**

We hire for values as much as experience, because mindset carries you through the parts no job description can predict. Here’s what that looks like day to day at Cuttable:

* **Be Brave & Own It**: you take smart risks and you own what happens next, good or bad. You own the outcome, not just the intention.
* **Create Customer Magic**: you listen hard enough to get to what customers actually need, not just what they said.
* **Say It (With Care)**: You say the honest thing, directly, and with genuine care for the person hearing it.
* **Progress Beats Perfection**: you’d rather ship, learn, and improve than sit on something waiting for it to be flawless.
* **Work Hard, Laugh Often**: you take the work seriously. Never yourself.

We believe you’ll succeed in this role if you:

* **Have 1–4 years making content,** at a startup, an agency, a brand or for yourself. If you’re earlier than that but your work is great, apply anyway.
* **Know what interesting looks like.** You can tell why a hook works and why a video lost people at second three, and you have opinions about it.
* **Make things without being asked.** You have a channel, a newsletter, side projects or a body of posts you’re proud of. Show us.
* **Are comfortable on camera.** You don’t need to be polished. You just need to be clear, natural and willing.
* **Can shoot and cut on your own.** A phone, CapCut or Premiere, and a decent ear for pacing.
* **Write clearly and fast.**
* **Are curious about ads and ecommerce,** or already obsessed with them. You’ll learn how performance marketers think: ROAS, creative fatigue, Meta Ads Manager.
* **Bonus:** you’re a creator with an audience of marketers, founders or ecommerce people; you’ve worked at an ecomm

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
At the intersection of fitness, health, and AI, Everfit is disrupting the $5.1 trillion market to become the leading platform for health and fitness professionals. We’ve built a business-in-a-box software for trainers and coaches to grow their business in any way they want and help them empower individuals to achieve their fitness goals. We’re proud to support over 400,000 coaches and millions of clients worldwide.

The possibilities ahead are limitless. As a global, diverse team of entrepreneurs, ex-founders, and fitness enthusiasts with experience at Nike, Apple, Meta, and Uber. We’re pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in health and fitness technology.

Join us in revolutionizing fitness and wellness with cutting-edge AI. Our vision is to empower every health and fitness professional with modern tools to unlock their potential and help more people live better lives. We believe in leveraging technology and AI to revolutionize the industry while keeping the human touch at the heart of coaching.

**Your Impact**

As an SDR at Everfit, you’ll be the first touchpoint between our brand and thousands of coaches and training businesses around the world. You’ll connect with coaches and businesses to help them take the next step with Everfit.

This role is more than outreach—it’s about making real human connections, asking the right questions, and helping passionate fitness professionals discover tools that unlock their full potential. You’ll be expected to adopt and creatively apply AI tools in your daily workflow to improve outreach, streamline processes, and drive better results.

**What You’ll Do**

* Connect with Coaches: Take discovery calls and product demos with fitness professionals and businesses to understand their goals, uncover their challenges, and showcase how Everfit can be the right solution for their coaching needs
* Qualify and Convert Leads: Identify the right coaches and training businesses, evaluate fit, and guide them through the decision-making process to become Everfit customers
* Craft Compelling Messaging: Create personalized outreach and follow-ups with strong storytelling and value-based communication, supported by AI when helpful
* Collaborate with Sales & Marketing: Partner with marketing on retargeting campaigns and pipeline strategies, and contribute feedback on trends and customer insights
* Manage and Organize Your Pipeline: Use Salesforce and other platforms to stay on top of leads, follow-ups, and performance metrics
* Continuously Optimize: Leverage AI and performance insights to brainstorm, test, and improve messaging and workflow strategies over time

**Who You Are**

* Driven & Curious: You’re energized by goals, love learning, and always seek better ways to connect with people
* Excellent Communicator: You write clearly, speak confidently, and know how to make a message feel personal and professional
* Organized & Adaptable: You’re able to juggle multiple priorities, manage a high volume of conversations, and keep your pipeline moving—even in a fast-changing environment
* Collaborative & Coachable: You welcome feedback, enjoy working with cross-functional teams, and are always open to growth
* Passionate About Fitness & Tech: You believe in what we’re building and want to help coaches make a bigger impact
* Comfortable with AI: You enjoy testing and applying AI tools to improve performance and are open to evolving how you work with new technology

**Preferred Experience:**

* 2+ years in sales, customer success, or business development—ideally in a startup or high-growth environment
* Previous exposure to CRM systems (like Salesforce), AI tools, and outreach platforms
* Experience in or deep understanding of the health & fitness industry
* Understanding of outbound and inbound sales strategies

**Why Join Everfit**

* Help shape how millions of people discover and connect with fitness coaches
* Work with autonomy and ownership on high-impact projects
* Join a collaborative, global team with experience from leading tech and fitness companies
* Enjoy competitive salary, equity, and performance bonuses
* Build something meaningful that helps people live better, healthier lives

This position is based in San Francisco in a hybrid working environment. We offer competitive compensation, equity, benefits, and the opportunity to shape the future of a product used by people transforming lives every day.

If you’re ready to build the future of fitness and wellness experiences, let’s talk!

jobs.description:
**About SpotOn**

We’re not just building restaurant tech, we’re giving independent restaurants the tools to compete and win. From our award-winning point-of-sale to AI-powered profit tools, everything we do helps operators boost profit, work smarter, and keep their best people. And every solution is backed by real humans who actually give a sh\*t about helping restaurants succeed.

* **Named the #1 Restaurant POS by G2** (Summer 2026), based on ratings from real users
* Rated the **top-rated point-of-sale** (POS) for restaurants, bars, retail, and small businesses by Capterra users
* Awarded **Great Places to Work** and Built In’s **Best Workplaces** for multiple years running

We move fast, care hard, and fight for independent restaurant operators to do what they love, and love doing it. If you’re looking to make an impact with heart and hustle, SpotOn is the place for you.

**Territory Sales Representative / Restaurant Specialist**
==========================================================

At SpotOn, you will be working in your local assigned territory and responsible for promoting our full product suite while building positive relationships with local businesses & restaurant owners to help take their businesses to the next level. We're looking for motivated individuals with an entrepreneurial spirit who excel at developing new relationships, deeply understand SMB's biggest challenges, and have the drive to make a significant impact in their local communities.

**Responsibilities:**

* Be a local representative for SpotOn in your community by offering advanced technology to local business owners that will help run and grow their businesses
* Travel to and from client sites within a designated geographical territory to prospect, build relationships, and sign up new local business owners and merchants
* Manage the full sales cycle from start to finish with a growing portfolio of clients
* Hit sales targets, with a particular focus on selling software & point-of-sale solutions along with payment processing
* Work closely with our extended Sales Support team to help reach your monthly sales performance goals

**Qualifications:**

Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend to apply to roles only when they check every box on a job description. We encourage you to apply if you meet the majority of our qualifications and if this role is aligned with your career trajectory.

* 2+ years of B2B sales experience with an emphasis on small business owners, merchants, and restaurants

* Proven track record delivering against sales goals with a metrics-oriented, need-to-win attitude
* Excellent cold calling, prospecting, and territory buildout experience
* Proficient in Salesforce as a CRM is a plus
* Maintain and manage the client relationship in collaboration with our internal support teams to ensure the success & satisfaction of your customer portfolio
* The ability to learn technology basics and apply them to business situations
* Ability to embrace feedback and hold yourself accountable

**Benefits:**

At SpotOn, we put people above everything else. We’re known for our innovative software and technology solutions, but we stand out because of the hardworking humans behind the tech. We can’t take care of our clients without taking care of our employees first, and that’s why we invest in your wellbeing with a competitive benefits package designed to support your health, family, and future:

* Medical, Dental, and Vision Options: Nationwide plans to fit your personal healthcare needs.
* HSA with Employer Match: High-deductible health plan enrollees receive an annual company contribution to their Health Savings Account
* Company-Paid Life Insurance & Disability
* 401(k) Retirement Savings & Annual Employer Match
* Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)
* Pre-Tax Commuter Benefits
* Paid Parental Leave
* Paid vacation, 10 company holidays (including 1 floating holiday), sick time, and volunteer time off
* Monthly cell phone and internet stipend
* Education reimbursement up to $2,000 per calendar year to assist with your professional development
* Employee Resource Groups to build community and inclusion at work

**Compensation:**

* A full-time, W2 position with an annual salary of $60,000 and total on-target earnings of up to $120,000-$275,000. Total on-target earnings are inclusive of base salary and commission potential.
* Please note the earnings listed are just one component of a competitive compensation package, which includes company RSUs.
* Commissions will be paid weekly for new accounts signed, bonuses earned for hardware and implementation, monthly production bonuses, and customer retention.
* Offers will be reflective of the candidate’s location and experience.

**Travel and Work Environmen**t:

* This role requires regular travel to client locations onsite for up to 6 hours per day, and the employee must have reliable transportation. Where driving is required, employees must hold a valid driver’s license, maintain a driving record that meets company standards, and have reliable transportation with active auto insurance. In dense urban territories (for example, Manhattan, NY), travel is typically by public transit or on foot, and driving may not be required. Working hours may vary based on client needs. The employee must be able to travel to and enter customer sites, which may include restaurants, retail spaces, warehouses, and construction environments, and to stand and walk for extended periods during site visits. Sites may not be controlled by the company and may have variable temperature, noise, lighting, and accessibility. The employee must be able to lift and carry items such as a laptop, demo equipment, product samples, or marketing materials weighing up to 10 pounds, including loading and unloading them from a vehicle.
