The Territory Sales Representative (TSR) is responsible for driving profitable revenue growth for Rainin products and services within an assigned geographic territory. This role achieves business objectives through a balanced focus on new customer acquisition, expansion of existing accounts, and development of emerging opportunities across target market segments.  
  

The Territory Sales Representative serves as a trusted advisor to laboratory professionals by identifying customer needs and delivering value-based solutions that include Rainin pipettes, pipette tips, calibration services and other laboratory research equipment. Through effective territory planning, consultative selling, and cross-functional collaboration, the representative is expected to consistently grow market share, exceed sales goals, and strengthen customer relationships across the territory. This is a field-based position requiring regular customer engagement, territory travel, product demonstrations, seminars, and participation in industry events.

* Demonstrated ability to develop business opportunities, build customer relationships, and achieve sales objectives.
* Strong territory management, organizational, communication, and presentation skills.
* Proficiency with CRM systems and Microsoft Office applications.
* Ability to work independently and effectively manage multiple priorities within a field-based sales environment.

* Medical, dental and vision care coverage and a 401(k) savings plan with company matching – all starting on date of hire

* Global market strength and worldwide leadership in precision instrumentation
* A brand name that is identified worldwide with precision, quality, and innovation
* Thousands of patents, design and innovation awards across Mettler Toledo
* Global recognition for the quality of our products and services

**About Mettler Toledo**

METTLER TOLEDO is a global leader in precision instruments and services. We are renowned for innovation and quality across laboratory, process analytics, industrial, product inspection, and retailing applications. Our sales and service network is one of the most extensive in the industry. Our products are sold in more than 140 countries, and we have a direct presence in approximately 40 countries. For more information, please visit www.mt.com.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. jobs.title: Social Media Manager
jobs.description:

------------------------------

Mancini's Sleepworld is Northern California's hometown mattress retailer, with 60+ showrooms across the Bay Area, Sacramento, the Central Valley, and the Central Coast. We're family-rooted, locally known, and growing fast, including welcoming Christian's Mattress Xpress showrooms to the family. Our marketing team runs everything from broadcast, streaming, and outdoor to search, social, and in-store promotions, and we're building a smarter, more content-driven marketing organization to support the next phase of growth.

**The role**
------------

Retail has become a content business, and this is the person who will tell the Mancini's Sleepworld story every day. You'll own our organic social presence across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and LinkedIn: what we post, why, how often, and how well it performs.

You'll turn everything happening across 60+ showrooms into content: store openings, our San Francisco Giants partnership, community events, vendor launches, our team, and our customers. You'll also work with our influencer lead to bring creator and customer content into the feed, so the brand shows up in more voices than our own.

*Strategy & editorial planning*

* Build and own the organic social strategy, content pillars, and monthly editorial calendar, aligned to the retail promo calendar and brand campaigns.
* Plan channel-specific content for Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and LinkedIn, and evaluate new platforms as they emerge.
* Plan always-on and tentpole content moments: Sleep Awareness Month, holiday sale events, Giants season, store grand openings, and community partnerships.
* Bring Luna and other brand characters to life on social in line with brand standards.

*Content creation & capture*

* Shoot, edit, and publish short-form video, photography, and stories, often on a phone, in showrooms and at events.
* Write captions and copy in the Mancini's voice; adapt campaign creative from the creative team and agency for each platform.

*Creators, influencers & UGC*

* Partner with our Influencer & Creator Lead on the always-on creator program across our creator verticals (moving & new homes, bedroom design, sleep health & recovery, couples & family, performance & wellness).

* Collect and secure rights to customer content and reviews for organic and paid use.

* Monitor and respond to comments, DMs, mentions, and reviews on a defined service standard, routing customer service issues to the right team.
* Spot reputation issues early and escalate them to the Director of Marketing with a recommended response.
* Support store-level community engagement: local partners, schools, sports sponsorships, and events.

**Qualifications**

* Portfolio of short-form video and social content you planned, shot, or edited yourself.
* Experience running influencer or creator programs: sourcing, briefing, contracts, usage rights, and reporting.

NYCHA has implemented a Zone Model approach, which leverages NYCHA’s and partner resources to expand economic opportunity for public housing residents through place-based service coordination. Through this approach, REES enables NYCHA to (1) Generate more economic opportunities for NYCHA residents and NYCHA neighborhoods, while strategically investing and leveraging NYCHA’s spend; (2) Provide a more comprehensive economic empowerment platform with additional capacities around financial literacy, asset building and business development; (3) Reduce the duplication of services – better investing limited resources; (4) Enable NYCHA to be a better partner to community-based organizations, government agencies, philanthropies, community colleges, schools, employers and other key stakeholders; and (5) Drive more resources and investment into public housing neighborhoods.
  
  
NYCHA REES seeks a dynamic Project Coordinator to join its Job Generation team. The Job Generation Unit supports NYCHA vendors and other employer partners with resident hiring, job training, and other economic opportunities in connection with Section 3 and other NYCHA hiring commitments. The team engages NYCHA residents, Resident Leaders and other internal and external stakeholders-connecting interested residents to upcoming Section 3 and other economic opportunities. The Project Coordinator will report to the unit Supervisor.

* Track project milestones, deadlines, and outstanding assignments.
* Assist with preparing progress reports, meeting notes, and project updates.
* Coordinate site meetings, inspections, and contractor appointments.

* Associate or bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and project management software.

* Construction project scheduling and coordination.
* Contractor and vendor communication.
* Project documentation and reporting.
* Material procurement and delivery tracking.

* Team collaboration and task management.

equip rising community and policy leaders to elevate the quality of discourse on U.S. policy toward Israel
  
and the Israeli-Palestinian conflict.

cities, policy discussions, and leadership initiatives across North America, IPF Atid connects emerging
  
leaders with one another and with IPF’s policy ideas and resources.

engagement, and day-to-day communications. Reporting to the IPF Atid Program Manager, the Associate

Good content takes more than creative ideas. It also requires planning, organisation and attention to detail to make sure information is consistent, relevant and ready to reach its intended audience. From coordinating content schedules to keeping digital materials up to date, effective content support helps businesses communicate clearly. We're looking for a Content Coordinator in New York, NY, to assist with organising, preparing and managing content across different business channels.

As our business continues to develop its communications and marketing activities, having someone who can coordinate content requests, manage deadlines and keep materials organised is important. This position is suited to someone who enjoys working with written and digital content, communicates well and can manage several tasks in an organised way.

jobs.title: Events & Development Assistant
jobs.description:
Integration Charter School is dedicated to providing innovative pathways to college that fully integrate students living with emotional challenges and others with special needs. In building a family of associated schools that share this common mission, ICS strives to fill gaps in public education. Through our wraparound service model, we remove obstacles and meet every child and family exactly where they are.

  

Summary

The Events & Development Assistant powers the fundraising, sponsorship, donor engagement, special events, and social media storytelling of Integration Charter Schools. Reporting directly to the Chief Development & External Relations Officer, this individual plans events that inspire, stewards the sponsors and donors who invest in our students, and helps each of our schools tell its story across every social media platform. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator, resourceful problem-solver, and strong multitasker who lives the ICS Bar: no excuses, no ego, and a commitment to do whatever it takes for our children, families, and faculty.

  

Our Vision and The Bar

Our vision is to reimagine what public education can be: schools that serve not only as centers of learning, but as hubs of opportunity and transformation for children, families, and faculty. Our commitment is simple but radical: we will do **whatever it takes** to set the standard for excellence for kids and families, pushing beyond compliance, beyond expectation, and beyond convention. The bar is high by design. In this role, the Bar means:

* **Leading with Love and Liberation:** every event and every post honors our students' dignity and celebrates them as they are

* **Doing Whatever It Takes, No Excuses, No Ego:** when a vendor cancels, a deadline moves, or a moment needs capturing at 7 p.m., you find a way. You own the outcome, not the excuse

* **Modeling Collaboration and Coherence:** you work across the development team, school leaders, and partners so ICS shows up as one organization telling one story

* **Holding Ourselves and Each Other Accountable:** you track every commitment, follow through on every promise to a sponsor or donor, and report results honestly

* **Building Schools Where Belonging Is Non-Negotiable:** our events and social media reflect every child, family, and faculty member we serve

  

Responsibilities

**Event Planning & Coordination**

* Plan, coordinate, and execute ICS fundraising events, friendraisers, and donor receptions from first idea to final thank-you
* Develop and maintain event timelines, planning calendars, task lists, and logistical checklists
* Coordinate venues, catering, entertainment, audiovisual needs, rentals, décor, photography, and other vendors
* Manage invitations, RSVPs, guest lists, seating, and attendee communications
* Coordinate event materials, signage, sponsorship recognition, student showcases, and promotional items
* Support event budgets, track expenses, collect vendor estimates, and maintain payment and invoice records
* Own event-day logistics, including vendor coordination, registration, guest management, and troubleshooting
* Prepare post-event reports, document outcomes, and coordinate thank-you communications

  

**Sponsorship & Corporate Partnership Support**

* Identify and research prospective corporate sponsors, businesses, and philanthropic partners
* Maintain sponsorship prospect lists, outreach trackers, and partnership databases
* Support the development of sponsorship proposals, packages, benefit summaries, and presentations
* Support sponsor outreach, follow-up communications, and meeting coordination
* Track sponsorship commitments, payments, deliverables, and recognition benefits, and make sure every sponsor receives what was promised
* Collect sponsor logos, advertisements, company descriptions, and other promotional materials

**Fundraising Support**

* Maintain donor and funder records, including contact information, giving history, and communication records
* Track fundraising goals, sponsorship revenue, donor commitments, and campaign progress
* Support fundraising campaigns, donor appeals, giving initiatives, and special projects
* Prepare donor acknowledgment letters and thank-you notes

**Social Media & School Storytelling**

* Manage and grow ICS's presence on Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, and emerging platforms, keeping every channel active, on-brand, and current with what is trending
* Partner with school leaders at each ICS school to capture photos, short-form video, and the voices of students, families, and faculty, so that every school tells its own story
* Plan and maintain a social media content calendar tied to events, fundraising campaigns, enrollment, and school milestones
* Create platform-specific content, including Reels, Stories, carousels, live event coverage, and LinkedIn posts that showcase ICS to donors, sponsors, and community partners
* Promote every fundraising event and campaign before, during, and after it happens, and deliver the sponsor recognition posts promised in each sponsorship package
* Monitor comments and messages daily, engage with our community, and escalate sensitive issues to leadership
* Track reach, engagement, and follower growth, and report results and recommendations to the Chief Development & External Relations Officer
* Follow student privacy and media consent requirements, including FERPA and ICS photo release procedures

**Administrative & External Relations Support**

* Provide administrative support to the Chief Development & External Relations Officer on departmental projects and priorities
* Prepare newsletters, event announcements, sponsorship materials, and other external communications

  

Qualifications & Competencies

* A “whatever it takes” attitude: no excuses, no ego. You own outcomes, solve problems on the spot, and put children and families first
* Alignment with the ICS Vision and the Bar, and a belief in inclusive public educ

As we grow our key accounts in the Southeast and on the West Coast, **we have two Account Coordinator openings** to keep those accounts running smoothly day to day. You will partner with our Account Manager and handle the daily details of our key accounts, so the Account Manager can focus on strategy, travel and growth. You will be the first point of contact for routine customer needs and the link between our customers and our operations teams.

### **What you'll do**

* Manage orders. Enter and confirm orders, track shipments and keep customers updated on delivery status.
* Be the first point of contact. Answer routine customer questions on availability, pricing and deliveries, and escalate bigger issues to the Account Manager.
* Coordinate with operations. Work with Logistics, the Vineland team and QA to keep orders on time and in spec; process claims, credits and adjustments.
* Support pricing and bids. Maintain price sheets, gather data for RFP/RFQ responses and send out crop and supply updates.
* Prepare reports. Pull sales and service reports, track progress against account goals and prepare materials for seasonal reviews and customer meetings.
* Keep things organized. Keep customer records and the CRM up to date, and help schedule meetings and travel for the Account Manager.

  
**Requirements**

**Required Qualifications**

* 2+ years of experience in customer service, sales support or order management.
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage many orders and deadlines at once.
* Clear, friendly communication by phone and email.
* Proficiency in Excel.
* Flexibility to work hours that cover Southeast and West Coast customers when needed.
* Eligible to work in the United States.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with ERP or order-entry systems.
* Background in food distribution serving retail customers, such as working with supermarket buyers, handling produce orders for retail chains, or managing customer communication around deliveries and claims.
* Familiarity with produce seasonality and PACA.
* Fluency in Spanish.

**What you’ll find at Trucco**

* Salary of $70,000 – $90,000 per year

jobs.description:

We're a company of people who like to forge our own path and leave the world better than we found it. Who believe that what makes us different makes us stronger. So add your voice. Make an impact. Find your fit — and your future.

As a Wholesale Account Coordinator, you will be at the center of one of Levi's most important wholesale partnerships, helping bring products, strategies, and seasonal launches to life for the Macy's business. Working alongside Account Managers and cross-functional partners, you'll drive order execution, support product launches, analyze business performance, and help solve challenges that impact the customer experience. * **Analytical Mindset:** Ability to work with sales, inventory, shipping, or business performance data to identify trends, monitor results, and support decision-making.
* **Collaborator:** Experience partnering with stakeholders across multiple functions to coordinate activities, resolve issues, and support business objectives.
* **Prioritization & Execution:** Ability to manage competing priorities, follow established processes, and adapt to changing needs. Manage multiple deliverables that require accuracy, organization, and adherence to deadlines.

* **Education:** Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.

jobs.description:
#### **About the Role**

At Xtremepush, we enable companies to build, grow, and retain strong customer relationships by delivering exceptional technology, expertise, and customer service. As a leading provider of customer engagement solutions, our mission is to empower businesses to create meaningful, personalised experiences for their audiences.

**Client Account Management & Relationship Development:**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for all customer account management matters for assigned accounts.
* Build and maintain strong, long-lasting client relationships, checking in frequently and regularly with clients.
* Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) with clients to review performance, discuss strategic goals, and align on upcoming initiatives.
* Develop trusted advisor relationships with key accounts, customer stakeholders, and executive sponsors

* Identify and pitch cross-sell and upsell opportunities to drive revenue growth.
* Negotiate contracts and close agreements to maximise profits.

* Ensure meticulous and regular tracking and updating of all tasks, client interactions and progress within HubSpot.
* Clearly communicate the progress of monthly and quarterly initiatives to internal and external stakeholders.
* Prepare detailed reports on account status.

* Resolve conflicts and provide solutions to customers in a timely manner.
* Escalate complex client requests or issues as necessary.

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure the successful execution of customer strategies.
* Develop and implement strategic plans to enhance customer satisfaction and loyalty. Ensure the timely and successful delivery of our solutions according to customer needs and objectives.

#### **Your Experience and Qualifications**

* Proven work experience in an Account Manager, Customer Success Manager or relevant role
* Have at least 5 years experience in a tech / SaaS company.
* Demonstrable ability to communicate, present and influence key stakeholders at all levels of an organisation, including executive and C-level
* Experience delivering client-focused solutions to customer needs
* Proven ability to juggle multiple account management projects at a time, while maintaining sharp attention to detail
* Excellent listening, negotiation and presentation abilities
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Familiar with SaaS customer management or have a background in data with a flair for client communication and understand consumer behaviour is desirable

This is a hybrid role based in the US (East Coast). #LI-Remote

Headquartered in Ireland with offices in the UK and US, Xtremepush is an Omnichannel Customer Engagement Platform powered by a built-in CDP. It enables high-velocity companies to build, grow, and retain strong customer relationships through personalised, relevant, and timely communication. With a true single customer view at its core, Xtremepush provides actionable customer intelligence that drives engagement, conversion, and revenue across all channels, while putting customer retention first.

jobs.title: Account Manager - NY (PST)
jobs.description:
**Account Manager**
===================

New York, NY (hybrid, Pacific time hours) | Full-time

Our pod is growing, and as new brands join, we're adding an Account Manager so every brand gets the attention and strategic care it deserves. You'll be the day-to-day lead for a portfolio of beauty and personal care brands on TikTok Shop, with a West Coast-based Senior Account Manager beside you on strategy and escalations, and you'll have the availability to work Pacific hours alongside your pod. The pod structure is new, so you'll help shape how it runs, and there's a clear path to Senior Account Manager as you grow.

**What you'll do**
------------------

You'll be the main point of contact for each brand in your portfolio and the owner of each account's plan and results. A typical week includes leading client calls, reviewing performance in Seller Center and Cruva, adjusting GMV Max ads against ROI targets, and turning each brand's goals into clear assignments for your pod. You'll work most closely with your pod's Creator Manager and Ops Specialist, who handle creators, sampling, and shop operations, and you'll partner with brand teams and their TikTok reps on launches, promotions, and product plans.

* Own GMV against plan for each brand in your portfolio
* Lead weekly client calls, including strategy and product planning conversations
* Assign and track work across your Creator Manager and Ops Specialist based on each account's goals
* Manage GMV Max ads day to day, including budgets and ROI targets, with input from Ops
* Build hero SKU, offer, promotion, and campaign plans with each brand, including launches and seasonal events
* Dig into what's driving performance up or down, and share what you learn across the pod
* Keep every account organized with clear owners, next steps, and fast client response times
* Manage relationships with each brand's TikTok Shop rep

**What you'll need**
--------------------

* 2+ years of experience in marketing, e-commerce, or agency roles
* Hands-on TikTok Shop experience and a working understanding of how the platform and its seller services work. Six months or more is ideal.
* Experience leading client calls and presenting strategy or product plans directly to brands
* Experience managing multiple accounts or projects at once while keeping owners, timelines, and next steps clear
* Experience directing or assigning work to teammates based on goals and priorities
* A track record of digging into why results changed and turning that into a clear recommendation

**What we'd like you to have**
------------------------------

* GMV Max experience. You'll run GMV Max ads on your accounts, so it shortens your ramp, but we'll train strong candidates who haven't used it yet.
* Brand-side TikTok Shop or Meta experience, or time at TikTok or another TikTok Shop agency. It helps you understand what brands need from us and how the platform works from the inside.
* Interest in beauty. Most of our brands are in beauty and wellness, so it helps you speak their language from day one.

**What we require**
-------------------

* You'll work from our Midtown Manhattan office four days a week, Monday through Thursday.
* **Regular overlap with Pacific time hours**. Your pod and many of its clients are on the West Coast, so plan for your day to run later than a typical East Coast schedule, with flexibility beyond that when clients need it.

**What we're counting on from you**
-----------------------------------

In your first 90 days, we'll be looking for you to take full ownership of your portfolio. That means you're leading every weekly client call, sending agendas ahead and recaps within 24 hours, and keeping a current plan for each brand that you review weekly with your Senior Account Manager. You'll have taken over GMV Max ads on your accounts with budgets and ROI targets in place, set a regular rhythm with each brand's contacts and TikTok Shop rep, and spotted at least one account risk early enough to fix it before it showed up in results.

By the end of your first year, you'll have built a quarterly strategy plan for each brand, led a quarterly business review on your own, and taken a product launch from plan through results. You'll be the pod's go-to person on GMV Max, your learnings will be shaping how other brands and pods work, and you'll have mentored a newer teammate along the way.

If you know TikTok Shop and want to own real accounts with real support behind you, we'd love to hear from you.

**About Spotlight Media**
-------------------------

Spotlight Media is a leading, award-winning TikTok Shop agency and an official TikTok Shop Partner. We help brands and creators scale on TikTok Shop through end-to-end management, paid creator campaigns, and a constant growth strategy mindset. We’re profitable, fully bootstrapped, and growing extremely fast.

Spotlight is a place for high-agency people who want ownership and autonomy and can operate with speed. Much of what we need hasn’t been built yet, and the people who join now will shape it. Our mission is for the time you spend at Spotlight to be the most rewarding time in your career.

**Benefits**
------------

* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* 401(k)
* Take-as-needed PTO after 90 days
* Office supply stipend
* Company bonuses
* Employee referral bonuses
* Brand referral bonuses

-

**Equal opportunity**
---------------------

Spotlight Media is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected by law.

Compensation Range: $55K - $110K

jobs.title: Global Account Manager, Media & Entertainment, Games and Sports
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS is seeking a world class sales professional to manage and grow our global business relationship with one of the largest entertainment and technology companies in the world.  
  
This Global Account Manager role will have a primary focus on the customer’s Telco and Media and Entertainment lines of business, responsible for business development and account growth for this global account. The ideal candidate brings deep industry expertise, a builder mindset, and the ability to engage C-suite stakeholders with credible, outcome-driven conversations — while thriving in a highly collaborative, cross-functional environment.  
  
The pursuit and management of net new customer relationships and incremental line-of-business opportunities will be critical to the success of this role. You will build and maintain key relationships, develop and manage opportunities, monitor deployment projects and engage resources to scale. You will define a CXO relationship strategy across the account and engage AWS senior leadership executive sponsorship and alignment, advancing a strategic business partnership and maintaining a trusted advisor relationship at all levels of the customer organization.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
The Global Account Manager (GAM) is responsible for teaming with the customer’s Line-of-Business (LOB) and IT Organizations to build strategic relationships across the account. The GAM is responsible for selling at the most strategic levels within the account and implementing a broad strategy for earning customer trust and service implementation. The GAM will work with all appropriate AWS resources (Executives, Solution Architects, Business Development, Marketing, Partners, Support, Service teams and Professional Services) to support customer interests. This includes dotted line responsibility for downstream sales and technical resources that may be geographically distributed.  
  
Business Skills:  

* Strategic account planning and executive relationship building
* Ability to articulate business value for cloud solutions
* Strong collaboration across cross-functional teams

jobs.title: Client Success Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Rebar**
---------------

Construction is a $2 trillion industry in the US alone. Most of it still runs like it’s 1995: PDFs, spreadsheets, and email.

Every commercial building starts the same way. Someone opens a few hundred pages of blueprints and counts every piece of equipment, duct, and pipe by hand. Then they price it, bid it, and chase it for months. That work decides who builds what, and for how much. It has barely changed in 30 years.

Rebar is building the AI platform the trades run on. Our models read blueprints the way a veteran in the trades does. Our agents then do the work that follows: counting the job, pricing it, managing the bid, and tracking it through to the order. Counts that took three days now take one. Customers spend hours a day in Rebar, and thousands of new plan sets flow through it every week.

We started with HVAC contractors and their suppliers. Every other trade comes next.

Here’s where we go: when a building goes up, the trades that build it run on Rebar. Agents win the job, run the job, and buy the equipment.

We’re about 50 people in Union Square, growing fast, and backed by top investors. We’ve built only a fraction of what we need to.

**About the Engineering Org**
-----------------------------

The role of the engineer is rapidly changing. We're aware, and we're being intentional about adapting with it. We are fostering an engineering culture of growth and development. We strongly emphasize care of craft and winning together. Our core values are:

* Everyone operates like an owner
* Find a way
* We win together

That being said, the whole company still works really hard! This is something that you should read and internalize. This might not be the place for everyone.

**About the Role**
------------------

We're hiring a software engineer to be the technical arm of our Client Success and Implementation teams.

As we sign bigger customers, every deployment comes with more technical work attached. A contractor wants their historical projects loaded in. Another wants our analytics piped into their ERP or BI tool. Another needs an API change, so their internal systems can pull takeoff data. Today, that work lands on the core engineering team as one-off requests, pulling them off the roadmap. We want one engineer who owns it.

You will still sit in the engineering org and have strong mentorship and learning. You'll come to engineering stand-ups, ship through our normal review process, and attend retros. Your priorities come from our customers.

You can think about this role almost as a forward-deployed engineer. You'll be on calls with customers, figuring out what they actually need and then building it. You’ll get to work with messy data, API integrations, and customer expansion.

We understand the challenges and sacrifices that come with joining an early-stage startup, and we want to emphasize that we're committed to ensuring you leave as a better, more experienced engineer and leader than when you joined. Here you'll own a hard piece of client-side engineering, and watch it scale from hundreds to thousands of users.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Own customer data work
* Build and maintain integrations
* Handle customer API requests
* Scope technical requirements with customers
* Be the escalation path for technical issues
* Turn one-offs into product

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

We want an engineer who likes talking to customers. You should be able to sit on a call with an estimator, understand how their team works, and then go write the script that fixes their problem. You'll be working with messy real-world data, so you should enjoy digging into it and not be scared of a 50,000-row CSV with inconsistent columns.

We are looking for engineers with good judgment, an inquisitive attitude, and the maturity to represent engineering in front of a customer.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* 2+ years of software engineering experience, or a technical client-facing role (solutions engineer, implementation engineer, forward deployed engineer) where you wrote real code
* Strong Python for scripting and data work
* Comfortable with SQL and relational databases (we're on Postgres)
* Experience working with REST APIs, JSON, and webhooks
* Comfortable talking directly with customers, from end users to technical stakeholders
* Writes things down. Your integrations and scripts should be documented well enough that someone else can run them.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Familiarity with TypeScript and React
* Experience with AWS (Lambda, S3, DynamoDB)
* Experience with GraphQL
* Experience with integration platforms or unified APIs (e.g., Merge)
* Background in construction, HVAC/mechanical, or another legacy industry
* Familiarity with estimating, takeoff, ERP, or project management tools used in construction
* Worked at an early-stage or high-growth startup

**Compensation and Benefits**
-----------------------------

* **Salary**: Competitive base salary
* **Equity**: Meaningful equity package, commensurate with experience
* **Benefits**: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
* **Perks**:

  + Agentic tooling budget
  + Lunches provided, dinners provided (after a set time)
  + Great culture in a high-energy office

This is a full-time, on-site role in NYC’s Flatiron District, steps from Madison Square Park and Union Square.

Occasional travel for on-site customer visits.

*Equal Opportunity*

*Rebar is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every background and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.*

Compensation Range: $120K - $165K

**About us**
------------

The Financial Times is one of the world's leading news organisations, globally recognised for its authority, integrity and accuracy, with a mission to deliver quality information and services worldwide.

At the FT, curiosity thrives and ambitious thinking is rewarded. Here, you're given the chance to reach millions, create work that matters and deliver impartial journalism in a polarised world.

In our warm, collaborative culture, you'll connect with a diverse community of experts who support your growth, career aspirations and wellbeing.

Your future at the FT will be filled with opportunities that challenge and inspire you. With no fixed path, you'll discover new skills and forge a career that can take you anywhere.

Build a newsworthy career at the FT.

We believe everyone should have a fair opportunity to contribute, succeed, and reach their full potential. That means ensuring everyone is heard, respected, and valued, while identifying and removing barriers that may get in the way. Our commitment is to be an employer role model, grounded in inclusion and fairness for all.

We are looking for an experienced Client Relationship Manager to lead and grow a portfolio of Corporate and Government customers throughout the Americas.

In this role, you will take charge of customer retention, revenue growth, and renewal strategy. You will build diligent connections with senior partners and see opportunities to grow accounts over time.

This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys handling sophisticated customer relationships, navigating commercial discussions and delivering long-term value to clients.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

* Deliver agreed retention and revenue growth targets, taking ownership of portfolio performance, account strategy and forecasting.
* Develop strategic account plans to protect existing revenue, identify renewal risks and pursue opportunities for growth.
* Lead renewal and growth conversations, developing proposals aligned with customer needs and navigating complex collaborator, budget and procurement processes.
* Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior decision-makers and key partners within customer organisations.
* Analyse customer engagement, account performance and market developments to find opportunities for retention and growth.
* Partner with Customer Success and other internal teams to coordinate account activity, resolve customer issues and deliver a consistent customer experience.
* Stay informed about relevant market and competitor developments and confidently communicate the value of FT products and services.
* Maintain accurate account records, commercial activity and pipeline forecasts in Salesforce.
* Proactively plan renewal activity, handle contending priorities and ensure timely follow-up across a varied portfolio.
* Collaborate with colleagues across the business to achieve shared customer and commercial objectives.

**Required skills / experience**
--------------------------------

* At least 2 years of experience handling B2B customer relationships or a revenue-generating portfolio, with a focus on retention and account growth.
* Strong commercial judgment, with the confidence to lead renewal, negotiation and expansion discussions.
* Shown ability to run multiple accounts, prioritize effectively and deliver against deadlines and commercial targets.
* Excellent relationship-building and influencing skills, including experience engaging senior customer partners.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to understand customer needs and articulate a compelling value proposition.
* A collaborative, customer-focused attitude, combined with the initiative to take ownership of work and follow through on commitments.
* Experience using CRM systems to handle customer activity, pipeline information and forecasts.

**Please submit your application by December 1st.**

**Desirable skills / experience**
---------------------------------

* Experience working with Corporate or Government customers, including familiarity with formal procurement processes.
* Experience using Salesforce and Google Workspace.
* Knowledge of Corporate and Government sectors across the Americas.

**What's in it for you? Our benefits**
--------------------------------------

Our benefits vary by location, but we are committed to providing best-in-class perks across all our offices. These include generous annual leave, health coverage, 401k and company match, inclusive parental leave packages, subsidised gym memberships and opportunities to give back to the community. Full details of our benefits are available here.

**Inside Sales & Field Sales Representative | Business Development & Lead Generation**

**Company:** Paper & Flowers

**Employment Type:**

Part-Time with Full-Time Potential

**Compensation:** Base Salary + Additional Payment Per Qualified Meeting Scheduled

**Work Arrangement:** Hybrid / In-Person / Flexible

**About Paper & Flowers**

Paper & Flowers is a Jersey City-based experiential production studio specializing in handcrafted floral installations, custom creative displays, and experiential brand experiences. We transform spaces and bring brand stories to life through large-scale paper florals, custom installations, branded gifting, retail displays, and experiential activations.

Our in-house team of designers and artisans manages every stage of production, from initial concept development and design to fabrication, logistics, and on-site installation. With a commitment to craftsmanship, creativity, and sustainability, our work has been featured in collaborations with some of the world's most recognized brands, including Dior, Valentino, the Met Gala, Swarovski, Netflix, and L'Oréal.

As we continue to expand, we are developing new service offerings that bring our creative capabilities to a broader range of businesses. We are looking for a motivated and results-driven sales professional to help introduce and grow one of our newest offerings: a recurring floral subscription service for restaurants, retail spaces, hospitality businesses, and other commercial environments.

**About the Position**

Paper & Flowers is seeking a proactive Inside Sales & Field Sales Representative to support the launch and growth of our new floral decor subscription service through outbound prospecting, cold calling, in-person sales outreach, lead generation, and business development.

This is a part-time position with the potential to transition into a full-time role as the service expands. The ideal candidate is comfortable making outbound calls, visiting prospective businesses, initiating conversations with decision-makers, presenting service offerings, and converting leads into paying customers.

Our new subscription model provides businesses with access to professionally designed floral arrangements through a convenient monthly service. Rather than purchasing new arrangements outright, clients can subscribe to a recurring service that allows them to use floral arrangements from our existing inventory, with seasonal rotations and replacements coordinated by Paper & Flowers.

The service is designed for businesses such as restaurants, hotels, retail stores, offices, and other establishments looking to maintain an attractive, elevated environment without the expense and responsibility of purchasing and maintaining new floral displays.

The primary responsibility of this position will be to identify prospective customers, introduce the subscription offering, explain its value, generate interest, schedule sales conversations, and help convert prospects into recurring subscribers.

This role will involve a combination of telephone-based sales and direct, in-person outreach. The representative will be expected to proactively contact prospective clients by phone and visit local businesses to introduce Paper & Flowers, connect with owners and managers, and generate new sales opportunities.

We are looking for someone with a natural sales mentality who is confident in communicating over the phone and in person, comfortable with cold outreach, and motivated by the opportunity to help develop a new revenue stream for an established creative business.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Outbound Sales & Cold Calling:** Proactively contact restaurants, hotels, retail stores, hospitality groups, offices, and other businesses by phone to introduce Paper & Flowers' floral subscription service and generate interest.
* **In-Person Prospecting & Door-to-Door Sales:** Visit local restaurants, retail stores, hotels, and other prospective businesses to introduce the service, connect with owners and managers, present the offering, and generate new sales opportunities.
* **Lead Generation & Prospecting:** Research and identify prospective clients, decision-makers, business owners, general managers, and other relevant contacts.
* **Product & Service Presentation:** Clearly communicate the benefits of the floral subscription model, including convenience, seasonal variety, access to existing floral inventory, and recurring floral updates.
* **Sales Development:** Build relationships with prospective customers, understand their needs, answer initial questions, and identify opportunities to convert leads into subscribers.
* **Appointment Setting:** Schedule qualified introductory calls or meetings with interested prospects and the appropriate member of the Paper & Flowers team.
* **Follow-Up & Relationship Building:** Maintain communication with prospective clients, conduct follow-ups, and help move interested businesses through the sales process.
* **Lead Tracking & Reporting:** Maintain organized records of prospects, calls, in-person visits, conversations, follow-ups, appointments, and sales progress.
* **Sales Strategy Collaboration:** Work closely with company leadership to refine outreach strategies, identify promising customer segments, and improve the subscription sales process.

**Ideal Candidate & Qualifications**

* Previous experience in inside sales, field sales, cold calling, telemarketing, business development, appointment setting, or a similar sales-focused role.
* A confident communicator who enjoys speaking with new people and initiating conversations both over the phone and in person.
* A natural salesperson with a proactive, persistent, and results-oriented approach.
* Comfortable conducting outbound calls and approaching businesses to introduce services and generate new opportunities.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to clearly explain service offerings and communicate value to prospect

jobs.description:
Discover Your Career at Emory University: Emory University is a leading research university that fosters excellence and attracts world-class talent to innovate today and prepare leaders for the future. We welcome candidates who can contribute to the excellence of our academic community. Description:

Program Coordinator, OUE Accommodated Testing Services

This is a 9-month position (August – May)

**Emory College of Arts and Sciences** (Emory College), founded in 1836, is Emory University’s primary undergraduate division with more than 5,700 students. Its intensive liberal arts curriculum is backed by all the resources of one of the world's top research universities. Emory College plays a critical role in supporting and expanding the liberal arts throughout the University and its nine

undergraduate and professional schools. This effort is led by the College’s renowned 550-member faculty who bring their path-breaking research – and commitment to excellent teaching – to the classroom. With more than 50 departments and programs, 86 majors, and 63 minors, Emory College students pursue rigorous courses of study that emphasize critical thinking, the nature of evidence from multiple perspectives and the ability to effectively reason and communicate. Emory College students are encouraged – and expected – to ask bold questions and expand the boundaries of knowledge.

The **Office for Undergraduate Education (OUE)** stewards the academic experience of undergraduates in Emory College. It promotes academic excellence by providing leadership and support across the College, both curricular and co-curricular. The OUE advances the vision of Emory College by collaborating with its faculty and Emory University partners to deliver a transformative liberal arts education. In this endeavor, it co-creates academic experiences that enable each Emory College student to reach their full potential and contribute meaningfully to Emory University’s mission to “create, preserve, teach and apply knowledge in the service of humanity.”

OUE Accommodated Testing Service (ACTS) offers in-person, proctored exams for undergraduate students in Emory College courses with Department of Accessibility Services (DAS) accommodations. OUE ACTS facilitates thousands of exams annually and plays a critical role in supporting equitable access to assessment for undergraduate students. This full-time, 9-month position is housed in the Office for Undergraduate Education as part of the Academic Affairs and Faculty Partnerships team.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

* Develops work plans to accomplish program goals and objectives and monitors progress toward their achievement.
* Conducts research and gathers information to develop various publications.
* Develops promotional materials which may include content for reports, briefings, newsletters, grants or other written information related to the program.
* Assists in developing and coordinating program-related conferences, conventions, or meetings.
* Monitors expenditures and may participate in the budget planning process and prepare financial reports.
* May assist in identifying funding resources and developing fund-raising strategies and initiatives.
* Prepares operational and statistical reports.
* Conducts training, represents the program at meetings and conferences, and networks with affiliated groups. May supervise assigned project staff, interns and/or volunteers.
* Performs related responsibilities as required.

ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITY DETAILS:

40% - Coordinate exam scheduling process for faculty and students with DAS accommodations in Emory College courses.

* Coordinate exam scheduling and rescheduling requests while interpreting accommodation requirements and ensuring compliance with university policies, testing procedures, and operational guidelines.
* Assist faculty with the completion of the Exam Accommodation Request Form.
* Utilize online forms, scheduling platforms, and databases to maintain accurate records and support daily testing operations.
* Coordinate exam details with OUE ACTS staff and/or graduate student proctors to ensure smooth and accurate operation.
* Audit testing records, student information, and exam documentation to ensure accuracy, compliance, and appropriate handling of confidential information.
* Ensure the confidentiality, accuracy, and security of student accommodation information and examination materials.
* Identify and reserve rooms for accommodated exams, maintaining a detailed list of room reservation details.
* Coordinate exam scheduling practices with other units such as OUE Operations, Academic Advising, Honor Council, and the Department of Accessibility Services as needed.
* Work occasional evening hours during peak testing periods, including midterm and final examination seasons.

40% - Manage communication

* Serve as the primary point of contact for OUE Accommodated Testing Services, providing guidance and support to students, faculty, staff, and campus partners regarding accommodated testing processes and policies.
* Manage the testing services email account and respond to incoming inquiries from students, faculty, and staff.
* Monitor communication with faculty and students via forms, website, and email, ensuring timely and accurate dissemination of information.
* Respond to complex inquiries requiring knowledge of accommodation practices, academic policies, testing procedures, and university resources.

We are looking for an experienced, well-connected **Outreach Coordinator** to join our growing outpatient behavioral health and substance abuse treatment program in **Chamblee, Georgia**.

This is **not a traditional entry-level marketing position**. We are looking for someone who already knows the local healthcare, behavioral health, and substance abuse treatment community and has **established professional relationships and referral connections throughout the Atlanta area**.

The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of developing referral relationships and will be comfortable getting out into the community, meeting with referral sources, and creating new opportunities for our program.

What You'll Do

* Develop and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective referral sources throughout the Atlanta metropolitan area
* Leverage established professional relationships within the behavioral health, substance abuse, healthcare, and community services sectors
* Conduct regular in-person visits with referral sources and community partners
* Build relationships with hospitals, detox and residential treatment programs, therapists, psychiatrists, physicians, private practices, case managers, social workers, EAPs, attorneys, community organizations, and other appropriate referral partners
* Introduce referral sources to our outpatient programs, services, admission process, and treatment philosophy
* Identify and pursue new referral opportunities
* Represent our organization at networking events, professional meetings, conferences, community events, and other outreach opportunities
* Maintain consistent communication and follow-up with referral partners
* Collaborate closely with Admissions and Clinical leadership to ensure a smooth referral experience
* Track outreach activity, referral relationships, and results
* Monitor the local behavioral health market and identify opportunities for growth
* Provide leadership with feedback regarding referral trends, community needs, competitors, and potential partnerships

What We're Looking For

**We are specifically looking for someone who already has relationships in the Atlanta behavioral health and substance abuse community.**

The ideal candidate will:

* Have established professional connections throughout the Atlanta behavioral health and/or healthcare community
* Be familiar with treatment providers and referral networks in the **Chamblee, Brookhaven, Dunwoody, Sandy Springs, Buckhead, Atlanta, and surrounding areas**
* Understand how behavioral health and substance abuse referrals move through the local healthcare system
* Have a proven history of successful community outreach, business development, or referral development
* Be comfortable making face-to-face visits and developing relationships with referral sources
* Be outgoing, confident, professional, and highly self-motivated
* Have excellent communication and relationship-building skills
* Be able to work independently while maintaining strong communication with the internal team
* Understand the importance of confidentiality, HIPAA, and ethical referral practices

Qualifications

* Minimum of **2 years of experience in behavioral health, substance abuse treatment, healthcare outreach, business development, admissions, or a related field**
* **Established Atlanta-area referral relationships strongly preferred**
* Existing relationships with hospitals, treatment providers, therapists, physicians, mental health professionals, or other behavioral health referral sources highly desirable
* Bachelor's degree preferred but not required with relevant experience
* Valid driver's license and reliable transportation required
* Ability to travel throughout the Atlanta metropolitan area on a regular basis
* Strong organizational and follow-through skills
* Experience using CRM or referral-tracking systems preferred

You already know the Atlanta behavioral health landscape.

You know who the major treatment providers are. You know the therapists, hospitals, discharge planners, social workers, case managers, and other professionals who make referrals. You know how to get a meeting, how to maintain a relationship, and how to turn a professional connection into a trusted referral partnership.

If you have an established network and enjoy being the person who knows **who to call, where to go, and how to get the conversation started**, we'd like to meet you.

You'll have the opportunity to help grow a new and expanding outpatient behavioral health program while making a meaningful impact in the community.

We are looking for someone who can **hit the ground running** and bring both experience and relationships to the role.

**If you already have a strong Atlanta-area behavioral health network, we want to hear from you.**

The Head Coach is expected to role model all of the qualities and attributes of an exceptional coach – the Head Coach is expected to coach an average of eleven (11) classes per week. Responsible for delivering a best in class experience, setting the standards for other coaches to aspire to. The Head Coach provides a high level of coach development, giving consistent feedback to their team with the ability to provide support in-studio throughout new coach trainings.

* Ability to lift / carry a minimum of 30 pounds.
* Proficiency in g-Suite and MS office, specifically excel and google sheets.

### **What skills and experience you will bring to us:**

* Optimism and hard work with a love for health, fitness, and the [solidcore] workout.
* Passionate about helping others become the strongest version of themselves and achieve their goals.
* Passionate about building relationships and developing teams, creating an environment that fosters growth.

[solidcore] is a national boutique fitness company with 100+ studios across the country. Our signature workout is 50 minutes of low-impact, high-intensity strength training: the lights are low and the music is loud. This class is accessible for all fitness levels and can be amplified or modified to accommodate individual goals. We are seeking a **Business Development Representative – Stone & Cabinet** to drive new business growth by developing customer relationships, reactivating dormant accounts, and expanding market presence in the field. This role is ideal for a sales professional who is strong in prospecting, customer visits, relationship building, and converting small or occasional purchases into stable monthly business. Experience in stone, cabinets, kitchen & bath, or related building materials is preferred.

About Us

BCS Stone & Cabinets Inc. serves local and regional customers with integrated stone and cabinetry solutions for residential and commercial projects. Backed by the broader Best Cheer platform, our business benefits from vertically integrated sourcing, manufacturing, and supply capabilities built since 1994.

We support fabricators, builders, contractors, remodelers, dealers, distributors, and other trade customers with slabs, prefabricated countertops, vanity tops, tiles, mosaics, façade panels, cut-to-size products, and cabinetry solutions. With factory-direct advantages, strong inventory support, competitive pricing, and responsive service, we help our customers source efficiently, stay competitive, and keep projects moving.

Why Choose BCS?

* **Fast Fulfillment**: Many orders placed before 12 PM can ship the same day, helping our sales team respond quickly and win business.
* **Sales Advantage:** Factory-direct pricing, strong inventory support, and broad product selection help our field sales team compete effectively and close business faster.
* **Global Powerhouse:** Work for a leader with 30 years of history and the country’s largest inventory of prefabricated stone and cabinetry.

Key Responsibilities

* Prospect and develop new business opportunities with fabricators, contractors, builders, remodelers, and other target customers in the local and surrounding markets.
* Reactivate dormant accounts and turn inactive customers into recurring purchasing accounts.
* Conduct regular field visits, customer meetings, and jobsite visits to expand market coverage and strengthen customer relationships.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with new and existing customers by understanding their project needs, buying cycles, and product requirements.
* Promote BCS stone and cabinet products by presenting product advantages, pricing value, delivery speed, and inventory support.
* Convert small or occasional purchases into stable repeat business by increasing order frequency, customer retention, and share of wallet.
* Follow up consistently on customer inquiries, samples, quotes, and open opportunities to move prospects through the sales pipeline and close business.
* Identify new sales opportunities through cold outreach, referrals, market visits, trade relationships, and account development efforts.
* Coordinate with design support, operations, and management to ensure accurate quoting, design follow-through when needed, smooth order execution, and strong customer satisfaction.
* Develop and manage a portfolio of self-generated accounts, building long-term customer relationships and driving repeat business growth.
* Maintain organized records of customer visits, pipeline status, account activity, and sales progress, and provide regular updates on market feedback and business opportunities.

Qualifications

* *2+ years of experience in outside sales, business development, field sales, or account acquisition.*
* Proven ability to prospect, develop new customers, and grow sales through relationship-based selling.

**ABOUT GREYSTAR**

Greystar is a leading, fully integrated global real estate platform offering expertise in property management, investment management, development, and construction services in institutional-quality rental housing. Headquartered in Charleston, South Carolina, Greystar manages and operates over $350 billion of real estate in more than 260 markets globally with offices throughout North America, Europe, South America, and the Asia-Pacific region. Greystar is the largest operator of apartments in the United States, managing over one million units/beds globally. Across its platforms, Greystar has nearly $79 billion of assets under management, including over $34 billion of development assets and over $36.5 billion of regulatory assets under management. Greystar was founded by Bob Faith in 1993 to become a provider of world-class service in the rental residential real estate business. To learn more, visit www.greystar.com.

**JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY**

This role supports and assists the Community Manager in overseeing and managing the financial and operational facets of the community by completing accounting and bookkeeping tasks, preparing monthly close-out and financial reports, processing invoices for payment, collecting rent, fees, and other payments, completing bank deposits, dispositions, and account reconciliations, and using the property management software to record, track, and report on all financial workings of the community.

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Property Type: Midrise**

**Stage: Stabilized**

**Unit Count: 152**

**Schedule: Monday-Friday + rotating weekends Job Requirements:**

* Completes the daily transactions and tasks related to the financial operation of the community by collecting and posting rent, fees, and other payments, preparing daily bank deposits and reconciling bank accounts, preparing financial reports, and processing invoices and payables.
* Operates the property management software (Yardi/OneSite) and completes transactions by entering all required fields correctly and by completing updates and back-ups to ensure the integrity of the system.
* Reviews resident files and accounting records to determine unpaid and/or late fees owed, communicates with residents regarding outstanding balances, implements procedures for collecting on delinquencies, and enforces the lease to maximize revenue.
* Reviews and submits invoices from vendors, contractors, and service providers for payment by reconciling work performed or products purchased, obtaining community manager approval, coding charges to appropriate Chart of Account codes, and managing communication between the vendor/contractor, accounting, and the client/owner as needed.
* Follows the Company’s established procedures related to evictions by following proper notice requirements, evicting residents, and representing the community as required in court hearings and eviction proceedings.
* Processes resident move-outs by reviewing lease terms and notice requirements, applying appropriate deposit and lease cancellation fees, if applicable, and processing the disposition in accordance with established procedures and legal requirements.

jobs.title: Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Organization Overview**

Nourishing Hope is a Chicago nonprofit working to end food hunger and address its root causes. Founded in 1970, we have evolved from a traditional food pantry into a comprehensive organization providing nutritious food, social services, and mental health support to individuals and families across Chicago.

We support the whole person with with respect, dignity, and compassion through:

  

* Five food access programs providing monthly groceries—including fresh produce, protein, grains, canned goods and other pantry staples—plus Bonus distributions offering additional food throughout the month.
* Home delivery for older adults, homebound neighbors and neighbors living with disabilities.
* Social services including case management, mental health counseling, job search support, domestic violence intervention, referrals and public benefits assistance (SNAP, healthcare, government forms) for anyone in need.

  

Each year, Nourishing Hope provides nutritious food and essential support to tens of thousands of Chicagoans. In 2025, we distributed more than 6 million pounds of food, served 50,000 neighbors, and provided more than 7,000 social services, including over 3,400 free mental health counseling sessions.

When you join Nourishing Hope, you become part of a team committed to making a meaningful difference in the lives of our neighbors and strengthening our Chicago communities.

**Position Summary**

The Program Coordinator primarily supports the effective delivery of Nourishing Hope’s food distribution programming, including the In-Person Markets, Home Delivery, and Online Market program models, as appropriate. This role supports all aspects of daily food distribution programming for Sheridan Market, including neighbor and volunteer engagement, operations and logistics, data tracking and reporting, and food safety and sanitation. This role acts as a liaison to all neighbors, volunteers, staff, and other stakeholders to ensure a dignified and respectful experience in alignment with Nourishing Hope’s Core Values.

**Schedule and Locations**

This position primarily works out of Sheridan Market located at 3945 N Sheridan Rd Chicago, IL and, based on organizational need, will occasionally work out of El Mercadito located at 3533 W North Ave, Chicago, IL. This position is fully on-site. The work schedule is Monday-Friday typically 8:30a-5:00p. Hours and other onsite location presence may vary based on programmatic needs.

**TOP 5 ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:**

* **Program Standards Execution** - Supports adherence to and execution of all relevant food distribution program standard operating procedures (SOPs) to ensure high-quality programming, food safety, workplace safety, and sanitation standards that adhere to organizational, state, and federal policy
* **Neighbor Services & Support** - Acts as a frontline point of contact for all neighbors, providing assistance and guidance, while effectively managing expectations regarding program processes, service availability, and other pertinent information with transparency and clarity. Fosters a welcoming environment for everyone, anchored in empathy and dignity
* **Volunteer & Staff Training** - Supports the training and supervision of volunteers and new program staff to assist with food distribution programming, in alignment with SOPs. Acts as the manager on duty, as appropriate
* **Data Management & Reporting** - Using required technology platforms, accurately inputs or maintains neighbor and programmatic data, produces and submits required reports, and tracks benchmarks/key performance indicators
* **Inventory & Partner Relations** - Appropriately supports inventory and relationships with The Greater Chicago Food Depository, U.S.D.A., FEMA, and other external partners

  

**OTHER RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Engages in cross training with all Nourishing Hope food distribution programs to ensure operational familiarity and providing coverage, as needed
* Acts as a spokesperson and champion for Nourishing Hope with staff, neighbors, volunteers, donors, government agencies, and other stakeholders in alignment with Nourishing Hope’s Core Values
* Provides coverage at times for others who are on PTO
* Supports training and onboarding for new teammates
* Perform other job-related duties as needed to support departmental and organizational goals

  

**SUCCESS CRITERIA:**

* Individual key performance indicators will be established annually in relation to annual organizational goals and priorities
* Attainment of organizational goals related to food distribution programming, including number of households and individuals served, number of services, and volunteer and neighbor satisfaction
* Builds collaborative, respectful relationships with colleagues, leadership, volunteers, neighbors, donors, and external partners
* Consistently demonstrates Nourishing Hope’s Core Values of dignity, equity, accountability, community, sustainability, and joy
* Consistently demonstrates Nourishing Hope’s Core Competencies of being mission-driven, strategic thinking, collaborative, inclusive, agile, and results-driven

  

**Qualifications**

***Required***

* High School diploma/GED or equivalent, college degree preferred
* Strong technology skills including:

* Working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite and Google Suite.
* Ability to use and maintain Salesforce customer relationship management (CRM) data quality.

* Commitment to Nourishing Hope’s mission and an understanding of and belief in the importance of food security for all
* Familiarity with the interconnected barriers experienced by neighbors experiencing food insecurity, including but not limited to homelessness, mental and physical health, disability, substance use, and aging-related barriers
* Ability to obtain and maintain food service sanitation certification in accordance with municipal and state laws.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills (in person, over the phone, remote

**Full Time** position in 1 North Wacker Drive Chicago, IL, 60602

**Job Title: Account Executive-Digital Marketing (Home Services)**
  
*Location: Chicago, IL-Hybrid/Remote*

**If you've ever sold digital marketing to a small business owner and actually enjoyed it — this is the role you've been waiting for.**

**About Us:**

Predictive Sales AI builds AI-powered websites and digital marketing tools specifically for home services contractors — HVAC companies, plumbers, roofers, landscapers. We help them show up online, generate more leads, and grow their business. Our clients are owner-operators who work hard and need a marketing partner they can trust. That's where you come in.

**The Role:**

As a **Account Executive** you'll be selling PSAI's websites, SEO, PPC, and Google Ads services to home services business owners across South Florida and beyond. This is a consultative sale — you're not order-taking, you're helping contractors understand why their current marketing isn't working and showing them a better path.

You'll manage your own pipeline, run discovery calls, present proposals, and close deals. The sales cycle is typically 2–4 weeks. Most of your buyers are skeptical at first — they've been burned by marketing agencies before. Your job is to earn their trust fast and back it up with results.

**What You'll Do:**

* Prospect and develop your own pipeline through outreach, referrals, and warm leads from our marketing team
* Run discovery calls to understand a contractor's current marketing, pain points, and growth goals
* Present PSAI's digital marketing solutions — websites, SEO, PPC, Google Ads — and tailor proposals to each client's situation
* Handle objections from skeptical business owners who have been burned by agencies before
* Close deals and hand off to the client success team for onboarding
* Hit monthly revenue targets and maintain accurate pipeline records in CRM
* Stay current on digital marketing trends so you can speak credibly to clients about what actually works

**What We're Looking For:**

**Required:**

* 1–5 years of sales experience — digital marketing, SaaS, lead gen, or related field
* Comfortable selling to small business owners — you understand how they think and what they care about
* Strong phone and video presence — most of your outreach and demos will be remote
* Self-starter who can manage their own pipeline without being micromanaged
* Genuine interest in digital marketing — you don't need to be a technical expert but you need to care about the product
* Based in or commutable to Boca Raton, FL for hybrid work schedule

**Bonus Points:**

* Experience selling to home services contractors (HVAC, plumbing, roofing, landscaping)
* Background selling SEO, PPC, Google Ads, or website services
* Sold for a digital agency, lead gen platform (Angi, HomeAdvisor), or local marketing company
* Familiar with contractor objections — ROI conversations, skepticism of digital marketing, long decision cycles

**Who Success Here:**

The reps who thrive at PSAI are hunters. They're comfortable picking up the phone, handling a tough objection, and following up until they get a yes or a no. They're also genuine — contractor owners can smell a pitch from a mile away, and the best reps here build trust quickly by being real.

* You're a closer — you know how to create urgency without being pushy
* You're resilient — rejection doesn't derail you, it refocuses you
* You're curious — you ask good questions and actually listen to the answers
* You're coachable — you want feedback and use it to get better
* You're hungry — you're motivated by commission and want to control your own earnings

**Why PSAI?**

* **You're selling something that works.** Our clients see real results — more calls, more leads, more booked jobs. That makes every sales conversation easier.
* **The market is massive.** There are hundreds of thousands of home services contractors in the US and most of them have terrible marketing. The opportunity is enormous.
* **You control your earnings.** Competitive base plus uncapped commission. The more you close, the more you make.
* **You're hybrid.** Work from home most of the time with regular check-ins at our Boca Raton office. No five-day commute.
* **You'll grow.** We're a growing company — reps who perform get more responsibility, better accounts, and a real career path.

**Sound like you?**

Apply with your resume and tell us in 2–3 sentences about the toughest SMB sale you've ever closed — what made it hard and how you got it done. That's all we need to get started.
