jobs.description:
**Sales Development Representative (Inside Sales) - Chicago, IL**

**\*Must live in Chicago, IL or surrounding area\***

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

We are looking for a driven, curious, and resilient Sales Development Representative to join our Inside Sales Team. This is not a holding pattern role; it is the first chapter of a clearly defined career in sales.

As an SDR, you will be responsible for generating qualified meetings through a mix of outbound prospecting and inbound lead qualification. You will work closely with your field sales counterparts to hand off those meetings, ensuring every introduction is well-briefed, timely, and set up to convert.

This role is also the foundation of your sales career. The skills, commercial instincts, and client relationships you build here are what will prepare you for promotion to Business Development Manager within 6 to 12 months, where you will own the full sales cycle from first conversation to close.

This role is built on two foundations. First, execution: showing up, doing the work, and consistently delivering output. Second, growth: developing the judgment, curiosity, and persuasion skills that turn a good SDR into a great closer.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

**Pipeline generation**

* Execute high-volume outbound prospecting via phone, email, and other tools to identify and engage potential clients

* Qualify inbound leads using a structured framework, assessing fit, urgency, and decision-making authority

* Book qualified meetings and hand them off to a BDM with a thorough, well-prepared brief

* Consistently meet or exceed weekly and monthly activity and meeting targets

**Client engagement**

* Research target accounts before outreach, understand their business, hiring challenges, and the commercial impact of those challenges

* Ask enough of the right questions during outreach to qualify the opportunity and set your BDM up for a strong first conversation

* Handle common objections confidently and credibly, influencing rather than scripting your way through conversations

* Follow up on the outcomes of your handoffs, stay curious about what happens after the meeting is booked and use it to sharpen your approach

**Collaboration**

* Work closely with your BDM counterparts, providing thorough meeting briefs and acting as a reliable first point of contact for new prospects

* Keep Salesforce records accurate and up to date, logging all activity and tracking pipeline stages

* Participate in call reviews, coaching sessions, and team huddles, rapidly applying feedback to improve your approach

* Contribute to a culture of high activity, honest feedback, and shared accountability

**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

We hire for two things: the ability to execute today, and the potential to grow into a future closer. You do not need to have worked in staffing before. You do need to be the kind of person who finds a way to get things done.

**Execution — you deliver consistent output and pipeline**

Grit / Resilience

You sustain performance through rejection. A tough week doesn’t derail you — it sharpens your focus.

Activity Capacity

You are comfortable with high-volume outreach and bring structure and energy to every day.

Work Ethic / Discipline

You manage your own time, set your own targets, and don’t need close supervision to stay on track.

Coachability

You take feedback fast and apply it faster. You see coaching as a competitive advantage, not a criticism.

**Growth — you have the potential to become a future BDM**

Business Acumen

You connect hiring challenges to business impact. You ask why, not just what.

Discovery Depth

You ask the question behind the question. You don’t surface needs — you uncover them.

Ownership Mindset

You think beyond the meeting. You care about outcomes, not just activity.

Deal Curiosity

You want to know what happens after the handoff. You use those lessons to get better.

Persuasion Skills

You influence rather than script. You adapt to the person in front of you.

Internal Selling

You collaborate well. You know that winning externally starts with alignment internally.

**EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS**

**Required**

* A genuine interest in sales and a clear desire to build a career as a closer

* Strong verbal and written communication skills, you can hold a conversation and write a compelling email

* A track record of hitting targets or goals in any context: work, academics, sport, or otherwise

* The ability to handle rejection and keep going without losing energy or professionalism

* Comfort with technology, CRM tools, LinkedIn and email sequencing platforms

**Nice to have**

* Prior experience in a sales, customer-facing, or high-volume outreach role

* Exposure to the staffing, recruiting, or workforce solutions industry

* Experience using Salesforce and sales enablement platforms

* A degree in business, communications, or a related field, though we care more about drive than credentials

  

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

In your first 30 days, you will have completed onboarding, learned our solutions and client base, started your first outreach cadences, and booked your first qualified meetings.

By 90 days, you will be consistently hitting your meeting targets, running discovery calls with support, and actively contributing to pipeline. Your CRM will be clean, your activity levels high, and your feedback loops fast.

By 6 to 12 months, you will have demonstrated readiness to progress to Business Development Manager, running your own full-cycle deals, contributing to closed placements, and showing the commercial judgment and client relationships that a BDM role requires.

**CAREER PROGRESSION**

This role is the entry point to a structured sales career at our business. Promotion to Business Development Manager is performance-based, not tenure-based. SDRs who demonstrate the right competencies and hit the right thresholds can progress in as little as six months.

As a BDM, you will own the full sales cycle,

FOR MORE THAN 80 YEARS, Natus has been committed to serving the varying needs of clinicians, delivering the highest-quality solutions to raise the standard of care for patients everywhere.

**Job Function:** Sales
  
  
**Job Family:** Inside Sales
  
**Job:** Inside Sales & Service Representative
  
  
Position Summary
  
The Service Inside Sales Representative is responsible for proactively growing service revenue by identifying, developing, and closing service opportunities across the Natus Sensory customer base and targeted prospective customers.
  
  
This role serves as a dedicated commercial resource for service and combines customer outreach, service-contract expertise, opportunity management, quoting, follow-up, and partnership with the field sales and service organizations.
  
The primary goal is to build a scalable inside-sales engine that protects existing service revenue, increases customer penetration, and creates new recurring service revenue by systematically turning Natus's installed base, warranty expirations, renewals, win-backs, and competitive opportunities into closed business.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Proactive Service Sales
  

* Conduct proactive outbound customer outreach against prioritized service-sales campaigns and call lists.
* Identify and pursue opportunities for:
* Service contract renewals
* Warranty-to-service-contract conversions
* Multi-year service agreements
* Calibration-to-contract conversions
* Win-back opportunities
* Lapsed or expired warranty opportunities
* Competitive service and calibration opportunities
* Engage customers approaching warranty, calibration, or service-contract expiration.
* Explain Natus service offerings and clearly communicate their value, including predictable service costs, equipment uptime, planned maintenance and calibration, and continuity of coverage.
* Consistently follow up on open quotes and customer opportunities through decision or closure.

Quoting and Opportunity Management
  

* Prepare accurate service quotes using approved pricing, service packages, and quoting tools.
* Work with customers to determine appropriate coverage, contract duration, equipment, and billing structure.
* Maintain visibility to the service-sales funnel and actively manage opportunities from identification through close.
* Escalate pricing, contracting, or operational barriers that may prevent an otherwise viable service opportunity from closing.

Customer and Install-Base Development
  

* Use customer, asset, warranty, service-history, and install-base information to identify whitespace and growth opportunities.
* Identify customer equipment that is approaching warranty expiration or is not currently covered under a service agreement.
* Identify customers receiving calibration-only service who may benefit from broader service-contract coverage.
* Support campaigns designed to penetrate the existing install base and identify competitive equipment and new service opportunities.

Partnership with Sales and Service
  

* Serve as an inside-sales resource for field sales representatives, service leaders, planners/schedulers, and other commercial teams.
* Support field representatives with service-contract questions, quote requests, equipment verification, and customer follow-up.
* Partner with planning/scheduling teams when their customer conversations identify interest in a service contract, warranty extension, or multi-year agreement.
* Provide a clear handoff path so qualified service opportunities identified elsewhere in the organization can be developed and closed by Inside Sales.
* Coordinate with Service, Customer Service, Finance, and Legal when an issue requires specialized support to complete the sale.
* Share customer feedback, competitive intelligence, pricing concerns, common objections, and process barriers with Commercial Operations and Service leadership.

Qualifications
  

* 2+ years of inside sales, account management, customer-facing service, contract sales, or comparable commercial experience preferred
* Demonstrated ability to proactively engage customers by phone and email and move opportunities toward a decision
* Ability to understand customer requirements and translate them into an appropriate service offering

**Executive Assistant to the Provost**

Benedictine University is an inclusive academic community, inspired by the Catholic intellectual tradition and Benedictine values. We seek employees who will contribute to the advancement of our mission by helping students shape lives of meaning and purpose as engaged citizens who care for the Earth, welcome people of diverse faiths and cultures, and promote the common good.

**Job Title:** Executive Assistant to the Provost

**Department:** Academic Affairs

**Reports to:** Provost and Vice President of Academic Affairs

**Status:** Full-Time, Benefit Eligible

**Location:** Lisle Campus, supporting University operations across both campuses

**Rate:** $60,000-$68,000 annually (based on qualifications and experience)

**Position Summary:** The Executive Assistant to the Provost provides confidential executive and administrative support to the Provost and Vice President of Academic Affairs. The assistant manages the Provost’s calendar and meeting preparation, drafts and coordinates communications, and tracks decisions and commitments through completion. The position also coordinates documentation for faculty personnel processes and academic appeals, supports the Academic and Student Life Committee of the Board of Trustees, and monitors designated Academic Affairs budgets. The role requires initiative, sound judgment, discretion, and responsive service to faculty, staff, students, trustees, and external partners in keeping with Benedictine University’s Catholic and Benedictine mission.
  
  
**Essential Job Responsibilities:**
  
  
1. Provost Executive Support and Communications: Manage the Provost’s calendar, appointments, travel, and meeting preparation. Prioritize requests in consultation with the Provost, anticipate scheduling conflicts, and ensure the Provost has the materials and information needed for meetings and decisions. Draft and edit correspondence, reports, presentations, and briefing materials for review. Respond to routine inquiries within delegated authority and direct sensitive or substantive matters to the appropriate University official. Maintain confidential executive records and track documents awaiting approval, decisions requiring follow-up, and commitments made by the Provost’s Office.
  
  
2. Confidential Academic and Faculty Processes: Coordinate administrative workflows for faculty appointments, rank and tenure, approved stipends and release time, and other faculty personnel matters assigned to the Provost’s Office. Receive and log materials, verify completeness, track deadlines, route documents securely, and prepare correspondence for review, signature, or distribution. Maintain secure records for academic integrity cases, grade and dismissal appeals, and student or parent concerns referred to the Provost. Refer substantive questions and decisions to the responsible administrator or committee. Support searches for academic leaders by coordinating schedules, candidate communications, and search records in partnership with Human Resources and the search chair.
  
  
3. Board Committee and Academic Leadership Support: Coordinate the Provost’s and Vice President for Student Life’s materials for the Academic and Student Life Committee of the Board of Trustees. Work with the Board liaison to confirm submission deadlines, assemble agendas and supporting materials, arrange meetings, and draft minutes or resolutions for review as assigned. Provide approved committee records to the Board liaison for official retention. Coordinate designated Academic Affairs leadership meetings and assigned joint meetings with Student Life by preparing agendas, distributing materials, recording decisions and assignments, and following up on deadlines.
  
  
4. Budget and Administrative Coordination: Monitor expenses against designated Provost’s Office, Academic Support, and Academic Affairs–Mesa budgets. Prepare and route purchasing and expense documentation, flag discrepancies for review, and follow up with Business and Finance and the responsible budget managers. Maintain a calendar of recurring Academic Affairs deadlines and coordinate document collection for assigned initiatives. **Elite Home Staging is growing—and we are looking for a driven, relationship-focused Sales Representative to help us bring in new business.**

If you are a **natural salesperson who loves real estate, luxury homes, interiors, and design**, this is an opportunity to turn those interests into a rewarding career with one of Southern California’s leading home-staging companies.

Elite Home Staging is the **third-largest home-staging company in Southern California**, with more than **200 homes across the Los Angeles market**. We specialize in beautifully designed staging for luxury properties and work closely with real estate agents, brokers, developers, builders, and homeowners to help properties make a powerful first impression and sell successfully.

THE ROLE

We are looking for an energetic **Sales Representative / Business Development professional** whose primary responsibility will be to **generate new clients and grow Elite Home Staging's business**.

This is a highly relationship-driven sales position. You will be responsible for building a strong network within the real estate community, identifying potential clients, developing relationships, following up consistently, and converting opportunities into new staging business.

You will have the opportunity to work directly with **top-producing real estate agents, luxury brokers, developers, and other industry professionals** throughout Southern California.

* Prospect and generate new business through **cold outreach, networking, office visits, referrals, events, and relationship building**
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with real estate agents, brokers, developers, builders, and other potential referral partners
* Regularly visit real estate offices and meet with agents to introduce Elite Home Staging
* Identify high-value sales opportunities and turn prospects into long-term clients
* Follow up with leads consistently and strategically
* Build and maintain a strong sales pipeline
* Schedule consultations, presentations, and property appointments
* Present Elite Home Staging's services with confidence and professionalism
* Educate prospective clients on the value of professional staging
* Stay informed about the local real estate market and identify opportunities for growth
* Represent Elite Home Staging at networking events, broker events, open houses, and industry functions
* Work closely with our design and operations teams to ensure a seamless client experience
* Maintain ongoing relationships with existing clients while continuously pursuing new business

DESIGN INTEREST IS A MAJOR PLUS

You **do not need to be an interior designer**, but you should have a genuine interest in **interior design, furniture, architecture, luxury homes, and current design trends**.

The ideal candidate understands that selling staging is about more than selling furniture—it is about helping agents and homeowners **position a property, create an emotional connection with buyers, and maximize the property's presentation.**

Your design eye will help you speak confidently with clients and understand what makes a home marketable.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for someone who is:

* **Highly motivated and sales-driven**
* Confident, outgoing, and comfortable meeting new people
* A strong communicator and relationship builder
* Comfortable with cold calling and prospecting
* Persistent and excellent at follow-up

* Passionate about real estate, interiors, and design

* A self-starter who can work independently
* Someone who genuinely enjoys networking and making connections

THE IDEAL BACKGROUND

Experience in **real estate, home staging, interior design, furniture, luxury sales, hospitality, recruiting, or business development** is a plus.

However, **we are more interested in your sales ability, personality, work ethic, and drive than a specific background.**

If you are someone who can walk into a real estate office, confidently introduce yourself, start a conversation with an agent, build a relationship, and ultimately turn that relationship into business—you may be exactly who we're looking for.

COMPENSATION & OPPORTUNITY

This position offers a **competitive compensation structure with commission and significant earning potential based on sales performance.**

The opportunity is ideal for someone who wants their income to reflect their effort and success.

* Work with a recognized leader in Southern California's home-staging industry
* Build relationships with **high-producing real estate professionals**
* Work around luxury homes and beautiful interiors
* Opportunity for significant commission and sales growth
* Be part of a creative, fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment
* Build a valuable network within the Southern California real estate industry
* Grow with an established and expanding company

READY TO MAKE AN IMPACT?

If you are **a salesperson at heart, love design and real estate, and are hungry to build a book of business**, we want to hear from you.

**Elite Home Staging is looking for someone who doesn't wait for business to come to them—they go out and create it.**

They will own meaningful financial workflows, work directly with the owner, improve how the business operates, and build systems that matter. It is an excellent opportunity for someone who is tired of being buried in a large company or limited to a narrow AP/AR silo and wants broader responsibility.

**Responsibilities**

This person should own the day-to-day financial workflows for a small operating business, with appropriate owner review and approval on major decisions and payments.

* Maintain clean, timely QuickBooks Online records and supporting documentation.
* Drive invoicing promptly and accurately; identify missing information before it creates a billing delay.
* Own the accounts-receivable rhythm: aging review, professional customer follow-up, notes, escalation, and collections follow-through.
* Organize accounts payable: receive and code bills, maintain vendor files, prepare a clear weekly payables list, and make sure nothing important is missed. Owner approval remains required for payments.

* Implement a consistent invoice-to-collection process and documented collection cadence.
* Clean up vendor, customer, and supporting-document workflows.
* Create clear SOPs for the highest-risk recurring tasks.
* Present the first practical automation / process-improvement recommendations.

* Deliver reliable recurring reporting to the owner.
* Show improved visibility into AR aging, invoicing status, and upcoming payables.
* Complete at least two meaningful workflow improvements that reduce manual rework or missed follow-up.
* Deliver a prioritized next-step plan for stronger controls, reporting, and sensible use of AI.

**What success looks like**

* Success is not just “the books are entered.” The right person makes the financial side of the business feel organized, current, and visible. Invoices go out on time, collections are handled professionally and consistently, vendor obligations are clear, records are easy to find, and the owner can see what needs attention without chasing information.

Qualifications

* At least 3 years of relevant hands-on accounting/finance-office experience.
* Recent hands-on experience with QuickBooks and the end-to-end cycle of invoicing, AR/collections, AP, vendor bills, and financial organization—not only one narrow task in a large department.
* QuickBooks Online, Excel, bank/credit-card reconciliation, billing, receivables, collections, payables, and basic reporting.

* A practical, privacy-conscious use of AI and automation. The candidate should be able to name specific workflows improved with AI or automation and explain how they protected customer and financial information.
* Comfortable making courteous but firm collections calls and documenting commitments.
* A demonstrated record of identifying a problem, creating a usable process, following through, and communicating clearly with an owner, customers, vendors, and teammates.
* The person must want to work in the office five days per week and have a realistic commute.

No CPA or bachelor’s degree is required if the person can demonstrate the actual skills, judgment, and ownership required for the job. A bookkeeping or QuickBooks certification is a plus, not a substitute for proven work.

Compensation and Benefits

NYC Ultimate Builders Corp is seeking an organized, detail-oriented, and proactive Construction Procurement Coordinator to support purchasing and supply management activities for construction projects. The successful candidate will coordinate material orders, communicate with vendors and suppliers, monitor deliveries, maintain purchasing records, and help ensure that construction teams receive the materials and equipment needed to meet project schedules and budgets.

Key Responsibilities

* Coordinate purchasing activities for construction materials, tools, and equipment.
* Request and compare quotations from suppliers and vendors.
* Prepare purchase orders and track approval processes.
* Communicate with vendors regarding pricing, availability, and delivery schedules.
* Monitor material orders and follow up on delayed or incomplete deliveries.
* Coordinate with project managers and site supervisors to identify material requirements.
* Maintain accurate procurement records, invoices, and supplier information.
* Track purchasing expenses and assist with budget monitoring.
* Evaluate supplier performance based on pricing, quality, and reliability.
* Support inventory monitoring and material replenishment.
* Resolve routine purchasing and delivery issues.
* Ensure procurement activities follow company policies and project requirements.

Qualifications and Requirements

* High school diploma or equivalent required; an associate or bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Construction Management, or a related field is preferred.
* Previous procurement, purchasing, construction, or administrative experience is an advantage.
* Understanding of construction materials and supplier coordination.
* Strong negotiation, communication, and organizational skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and purchasing software.
* Ability to manage multiple orders and meet deadlines.
* Strong attention to detail and recordkeeping abilities.

Preferred Skills

* Construction material procurement.
* Vendor and supplier relationship management.
* Purchase order preparation and tracking.
* Inventory and delivery coordination.
* Cost comparison and budget monitoring.
* Invoice verification and documentation.
* Problem-solving and time management.

Work Environment

This position involves office-based procurement coordination with regular communication among project managers, construction teams, vendors, and suppliers. Occasional construction site visits may be required to review material needs and coordinate deliveries.

Career Progression

With additional experience and professional development, employees may pursue advancement into senior procurement coordination, purchasing management, supply chain management, materials management, or construction operations roles.

Benefits

Potential benefits may include paid time off, professional development opportunities, training, and other employment benefits, depending on company policy, employment status, location, and eligibility.

About the Company

NYC Ultimate Builders Corp is identified as the employer for this opportunity. Applicants should contact the company directly to confirm its current construction services, procurement responsibilities, project assignments, and employment details.

How to Apply

Interested candidates should submit an updated résumé highlighting relevant purchasing, procurement, supply chain, construction administration, or vendor coordination experience. Qualified applicants may be contacted for additional information and an interview.

Pay: $20.00 - $25.00 per hour

Expected hours: 45.0 per week

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Relocation assistance
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

new_jobs.title: Account Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**Hello #TruccoPeople!**  
Trucco is a family-owned importer and nationwide distributor of fresh produce, dried fruits and nuts. Founded in 1937 and headquartered at the Hunts Point Terminal Market (Bronx, NY), we operate a 200,000 sq. ft. distribution center in Vineland, NJ. Our programs include kiwifruit, citrus, grapes, chestnuts and more, sourced worldwide for year-round supply. Trucco is part of Orsero Group, one of Europe's leading fresh produce distributors.
  
  
**The role**  
As we grow our key accounts in the Southeast and on the West Coast, **we have two Account Coordinator openings** to keep those accounts running smoothly day to day. You will partner with our Account Manager and handle the daily details of our key accounts, so the Account Manager can focus on strategy, travel and growth. You will be the first point of contact for routine customer needs and the link between our customers and our operations teams.

### **What you'll do**

* Manage orders. Enter and confirm orders, track shipments and keep customers updated on delivery status.
* Be the first point of contact. Answer routine customer questions on availability, pricing and deliveries, and escalate bigger issues to the Account Manager.
* Coordinate with operations. Work with Logistics, the Vineland team and QA to keep orders on time and in spec; process claims, credits and adjustments.
* Support pricing and bids. Maintain price sheets, gather data for RFP/RFQ responses and send out crop and supply updates.
* Prepare reports. Pull sales and service reports, track progress against account goals and prepare materials for seasonal reviews and customer meetings.
* Keep things organized. Keep customer records and the CRM up to date, and help schedule meetings and travel for the Account Manager.

  
**Requirements**

**Required Qualifications**

* 2+ years of experience in customer service, sales support or order management.
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage many orders and deadlines at once.
* Clear, friendly communication by phone and email.
* Proficiency in Excel.
* Flexibility to work hours that cover Southeast and West Coast customers when needed.
* Eligible to work in the United States.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with ERP or order-entry systems.
* Background in food distribution serving retail customers, such as working with supermarket buyers, handling produce orders for retail chains, or managing customer communication around deliveries and claims.
* Familiarity with produce seasonality and PACA.
* Fluency in Spanish.

  
**Benefits**

**What you’ll find at Trucco**

* Salary of $70,000 – $90,000 per year
* Health, dental and vision insurance
* 401(k)
* Paid time off
* A clear growth path toward an Account Manager role
* The stability of a family-owned company with nearly 90 years in produce, backed by an international group

*Trucco, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.*

new_jobs.title: Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
#### **About the Role**

At Xtremepush, we enable companies to build, grow, and retain strong customer relationships by delivering exceptional technology, expertise, and customer service. As a leading provider of customer engagement solutions, our mission is to empower businesses to create meaningful, personalised experiences for their audiences.  
  
Due to rapid growth, we’re seeking an Account Manager to join our high-performing team. In this role, you will be pivotal in fostering long-term, trusted partnerships with some of our most valuable customers. By driving revenue retention and growth through relationship building, cross-selling, and upselling, you’ll directly contribute to our company’s success.  
  
As an Account Manager, you will play a key role in ensuring our customers achieve exceptional outcomes through our platform. By leveraging your expertise and interpersonal skills, you’ll help them realise the full value of their investment, fostering product adoption, expansion, and retention.  
  
This is a hybrid role (East Coast timezone). #LI-Remote

#### **Key Responsibilities**

**Client Account Management & Relationship Development:**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for all customer account management matters for assigned accounts.
* Build and maintain strong, long-lasting client relationships, checking in frequently and regularly with clients.
* Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) with clients to review performance, discuss strategic goals, and align on upcoming initiatives.
* Develop trusted advisor relationships with key accounts, customer stakeholders, and executive sponsors

**Business Development:**

* Identify and pitch cross-sell and upsell opportunities to drive revenue growth.
* Negotiate contracts and close agreements to maximise profits.

**Reporting & Operations:**

* Ensure meticulous and regular tracking and updating of all tasks, client interactions and progress within HubSpot.
* Clearly communicate the progress of monthly and quarterly initiatives to internal and external stakeholders.
* Prepare detailed reports on account status.
* Forecast and track key account metrics, such as quarterly sales results and annual forecasts.

**Client Partnership:**

* Resolve conflicts and provide solutions to customers in a timely manner.
* Escalate complex client requests or issues as necessary.
* Act as the voice of the customer within Xtremepush, ensuring their needs and feedback are effectively communicated and addressed.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure the successful execution of customer strategies.
* Develop and implement strategic plans to enhance customer satisfaction and loyalty. Ensure the timely and successful delivery of our solutions according to customer needs and objectives.

#### **Your Experience and Qualifications**

* Proven work experience in an Account Manager, Customer Success Manager or relevant role
* Have at least 5 years experience in a tech / SaaS company.
* Demonstrable ability to communicate, present and influence key stakeholders at all levels of an organisation, including executive and C-level
* Experience delivering client-focused solutions to customer needs
* Proven ability to juggle multiple account management projects at a time, while maintaining sharp attention to detail
* Excellent listening, negotiation and presentation abilities
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Familiar with SaaS customer management or have a background in data with a flair for client communication and understand consumer behaviour is desirable
* Additional language is desirable

#### **Location**

This is a hybrid role based in the US (East Coast). #LI-Remote

#### **About us**

Headquartered in Ireland with offices in the UK and US, Xtremepush is an Omnichannel Customer Engagement Platform powered by a built-in CDP. It enables high-velocity companies to build, grow, and retain strong customer relationships through personalised, relevant, and timely communication. With a true single customer view at its core, Xtremepush provides actionable customer intelligence that drives engagement, conversion, and revenue across all channels, while putting customer retention first.  
  
*At Xtremepush, we believe that diversity adds incredible value to our teams, our products, and our culture. We don’t just accept differences, we celebrate it, we support it, and we thrive on it for the benefit of our employees, our products and our community. As an equal opportunity employer, we stay true to our mission by ensuring that our place can be anyone’s place regardless of race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.*

We are seeking a **Account Manager**. This position is an integral member of the **Mid-Atlantic** Regions management team will be directly responsible for leading commercial cleaning operations, ensuring that service commitments are fully met, and that the business exceeds budget and growth expectations. This position is responsible for overseeing the scheduling of service, training, and performance management of staff, and in meeting all operational and sales expectations for the assigned Market. This position is also responsible for managing corporate expenses related to customer deliveries; and is expected to add corporate revenues through the sales of other services to current customers, while assisting the sales team in developing an additional customer base. This position will report to the VP of Operations.

**Duties Include:**

* Ensure the development of long-term strategy as well as sound annual business plans to develop growth.

* Oversee daily operations and sales activity, budgets, and team personnel.

* Manage corporation expenses relating to cleaning services including delivery costs, labor costs, supplies, etc.

* Meet regularly with clients to ensure their satisfaction with current contract services and to identify their changing needs and requirements. Building strong tenant relations through timely communications and meeting regularly in person.

* Review service delivery and staffing reports to ensure identification of service and/or contract issues.

* Analyze processes and practices considering customer needs and service expectation.

* Meet with company leaders to evaluate location performance, understand opportunities to enhance service effectiveness, and to gain insight to regulatory trends that may impact the business.

* Understand all customer contract commitments and schedule services accordingly.

* Allocate resources appropriate for customer sites and maintain appropriate inventories of supplies.

* Meet regularly with Operations and Sales staff and in addition to customers to monitor service delivery performance, identifying any deficiencies in delivery.

* Oversee the recruitment of cleaning staff, the training orientation of new staff and the continual development of new staff.

* Interaction with senior level managers and or ownership of both current and potential clients to promote business.

* Other duties as needed by company.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree preferred

* Minimum Five (5) years progression in a janitorial or alike industry. Operations management and/or building/facilities management in a Class A building and a working knowledge of the cleaning service industry is preferred.

* Strong communication skills both verbally and written ability to communicate effectively, responding timely with building owners, senior management staff, clients, vendors, and staff.

* Effective problem solving, leadership, organizational and planning skills.

* Strong business development experience, skills, and ideas.

**Compensation:**

* Salary: **$35.00 per hour**

* Paid holidays and vacation time

* Health Benefits Package

* Ancillary benefits—Life insurance, Long Term Disability, FSA, and Dependent Spending care

* 401K

* Opportunity for growth

**Pritchard Industries participates in E-Verify.**

#### **Behaviors**

Preferred

* Thought Provoking: Capable of making others think deeply on a subject
* Team Player: Works well as a member of a group
* Leader: Inspires teammates to follow them
* Enthusiastic: Shows intense and eager enjoyment and interest
* Detail Oriented: Capable of carrying out a given task with all details necessary to get the task done well
* Dedicated: Devoted to a task or purpose with loyalty or integrity

#### **Motivations**

Preferred

* Self-Starter: Inspired to perform without outside help
* Peer Recognition: Inspired to perform well by the praise of coworkers
* Goal Completion: Inspired to perform well by the completion of tasks
* Flexibility: Inspired to perform well when granted the ability to set your own schedule and goals
* Ability to Make an Impact: Inspired to perform well by the ability to contribute to the success of a project or the organization

Equal Opportunity Employer  
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

new_jobs.title: Account Manager - NY (PST)
new_jobs.description:
**Account Manager**
===================

New York, NY (hybrid, Pacific time hours) | Full-time

Our pod is growing, and as new brands join, we're adding an Account Manager so every brand gets the attention and strategic care it deserves. You'll be the day-to-day lead for a portfolio of beauty and personal care brands on TikTok Shop, with a West Coast-based Senior Account Manager beside you on strategy and escalations, and you'll have the availability to work Pacific hours alongside your pod. The pod structure is new, so you'll help shape how it runs, and there's a clear path to Senior Account Manager as you grow.

**What you'll do**
------------------

You'll be the main point of contact for each brand in your portfolio and the owner of each account's plan and results. A typical week includes leading client calls, reviewing performance in Seller Center and Cruva, adjusting GMV Max ads against ROI targets, and turning each brand's goals into clear assignments for your pod. You'll work most closely with your pod's Creator Manager and Ops Specialist, who handle creators, sampling, and shop operations, and you'll partner with brand teams and their TikTok reps on launches, promotions, and product plans.

* Own GMV against plan for each brand in your portfolio
* Lead weekly client calls, including strategy and product planning conversations
* Assign and track work across your Creator Manager and Ops Specialist based on each account's goals
* Manage GMV Max ads day to day, including budgets and ROI targets, with input from Ops
* Build hero SKU, offer, promotion, and campaign plans with each brand, including launches and seasonal events
* Dig into what's driving performance up or down, and share what you learn across the pod
* Keep every account organized with clear owners, next steps, and fast client response times
* Manage relationships with each brand's TikTok Shop rep

**What you'll need**
--------------------

* 2+ years of experience in marketing, e-commerce, or agency roles
* Hands-on TikTok Shop experience and a working understanding of how the platform and its seller services work. Six months or more is ideal.
* Experience leading client calls and presenting strategy or product plans directly to brands
* Experience managing multiple accounts or projects at once while keeping owners, timelines, and next steps clear
* Experience directing or assigning work to teammates based on goals and priorities
* A track record of digging into why results changed and turning that into a clear recommendation

**What we'd like you to have**
------------------------------

* GMV Max experience. You'll run GMV Max ads on your accounts, so it shortens your ramp, but we'll train strong candidates who haven't used it yet.
* Brand-side TikTok Shop or Meta experience, or time at TikTok or another TikTok Shop agency. It helps you understand what brands need from us and how the platform works from the inside.
* Interest in beauty. Most of our brands are in beauty and wellness, so it helps you speak their language from day one.

**What we require**
-------------------

* You'll work from our Midtown Manhattan office four days a week, Monday through Thursday.
* **Regular overlap with Pacific time hours**. Your pod and many of its clients are on the West Coast, so plan for your day to run later than a typical East Coast schedule, with flexibility beyond that when clients need it.

**What we're counting on from you**
-----------------------------------

In your first 90 days, we'll be looking for you to take full ownership of your portfolio. That means you're leading every weekly client call, sending agendas ahead and recaps within 24 hours, and keeping a current plan for each brand that you review weekly with your Senior Account Manager. You'll have taken over GMV Max ads on your accounts with budgets and ROI targets in place, set a regular rhythm with each brand's contacts and TikTok Shop rep, and spotted at least one account risk early enough to fix it before it showed up in results.

By the end of your first year, you'll have built a quarterly strategy plan for each brand, led a quarterly business review on your own, and taken a product launch from plan through results. You'll be the pod's go-to person on GMV Max, your learnings will be shaping how other brands and pods work, and you'll have mentored a newer teammate along the way.

If you know TikTok Shop and want to own real accounts with real support behind you, we'd love to hear from you.

**About Spotlight Media**
-------------------------

Spotlight Media is a leading, award-winning TikTok Shop agency and an official TikTok Shop Partner. We help brands and creators scale on TikTok Shop through end-to-end management, paid creator campaigns, and a constant growth strategy mindset. We’re profitable, fully bootstrapped, and growing extremely fast.

Spotlight is a place for high-agency people who want ownership and autonomy and can operate with speed. Much of what we need hasn’t been built yet, and the people who join now will shape it. Our mission is for the time you spend at Spotlight to be the most rewarding time in your career.

**Benefits**
------------

* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* 401(k)
* Take-as-needed PTO after 90 days
* Office supply stipend
* Company bonuses
* Employee referral bonuses
* Brand referral bonuses

-

**Equal opportunity**
---------------------

Spotlight Media is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected by law.

Compensation Range: $55K - $110K

new_jobs.title: Global Account Manager, Media & Entertainment, Games and Sports
new_jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS is seeking a world class sales professional to manage and grow our global business relationship with one of the largest entertainment and technology companies in the world.  
  
This Global Account Manager role will have a primary focus on the customer’s Telco and Media and Entertainment lines of business, responsible for business development and account growth for this global account. The ideal candidate brings deep industry expertise, a builder mindset, and the ability to engage C-suite stakeholders with credible, outcome-driven conversations — while thriving in a highly collaborative, cross-functional environment.  
  
The pursuit and management of net new customer relationships and incremental line-of-business opportunities will be critical to the success of this role. You will build and maintain key relationships, develop and manage opportunities, monitor deployment projects and engage resources to scale. You will define a CXO relationship strategy across the account and engage AWS senior leadership executive sponsorship and alignment, advancing a strategic business partnership and maintaining a trusted advisor relationship at all levels of the customer organization.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
The Global Account Manager (GAM) is responsible for teaming with the customer’s Line-of-Business (LOB) and IT Organizations to build strategic relationships across the account. The GAM is responsible for selling at the most strategic levels within the account and implementing a broad strategy for earning customer trust and service implementation. The GAM will work with all appropriate AWS resources (Executives, Solution Architects, Business Development, Marketing, Partners, Support, Service teams and Professional Services) to support customer interests. This includes dotted line responsibility for downstream sales and technical resources that may be geographically distributed.  
  
Business Skills:  

* Strategic account planning and executive relationship building
* Ability to articulate business value for cloud solutions
* Strong collaboration across cross-functional teams
* Experience with partner ecosystem
* Excellent presentation and communication skills

  
Cloud Knowledge:  

* Understanding of core cloud services relevant to sports workloads (compute, storage, databases, analytics, ML/AI, security)
* Familiarity with cloud partner ecosystems and Professional Services capabilities
* Ability to connect customer business challenges to cloud-based solutions

  
Opportunity Development & Execution:  

* Drive opportunities with a focus on measurable business outcomes
* Collaborate with industry specialists to evangelize cloud services, partner solutions, and Professional Services.
* Participate in executive engagements with C-suite stakeholders

  
A day in the life  
  
Diverse Experiences  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  
  
Why AWS?  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 10+ years of technology sales experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 7+ years of creating and implementing long-term transformational account strategies in a customer-facing role or equivalent experience
* Experience in cross functional selling (architect, sales engineer, professional services, partner, and ISV)
* 10+ years of technology related sales, business development or equivalent experience
* 7+ years of hands-on work managing complex technology projects experience
* Knowledge of AWS or technology as a service (IaaS, SaaS, PaaS)

  
Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  
  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments, restricted stock units (RSUs), and sales incentives. Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits.

  
USA, NY, New York - 157,100.00 - 212,600.00 USD annually

new_jobs.title: National Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

The Portfolio Group, under the Workplace Experience Group umbrella, delivers seamless experiences from the breakroom to the boardroom, providing a signature suite of services for each unique business portfolio. Our team builds partnerships that excel, creating experiences that break the mold, where convenience, consistency, and excellence are a given. One Partner. Infinite Solutions. As a General Manager you will plan, manage, and guide contracted services for multiple sites for a client or for multiple clients normally generating $2-15M+ in revenue to meet operating and financial goals, client objectives, and customer needs.

Depending on the client(s), services can include food service, facility support, custodial services, retail, lodging, transportation, and more. Our General Managers are capable operations managers who lead a team to provide excellent service to our clients. With knowledge of the client's business, positive relationship building skills, financial savvy, and a focus on safety, our team makes a difference every day.

**Compensation Data**
---------------------

COMPENSATION: The Salaried rate for this position is $125,000.00 to $135,000.00. If both numbers are the same, that is the amount that Aramark expects to offer. This is Aramark's good faith and reasonable estimate of the compensation for this position as of the time of posting.

BENEFITS: Aramark offers comprehensive benefit programs and services for eligible employees including medical, dental, vision, and work/life resources. Additional benefits may include retirement savings plans like 401(k) and paid days off such as parental leave and disability coverage. Benefits vary by location and are subject to any legal requirements or limitations, employee eligibility status, and where the employee lives and/or works. For more information about Aramark benefits, click here Aramark Careers - Benefits & Compensation

There is no predetermined application window for this position, the position will close once a qualified candidate is selected. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all applicable laws, including, but not limited to all applicable Fair Chance Ordinances and Acts. For jobs in San Francisco, this includes the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

**Job Responsibilities**
------------------------

The successful General Manager:

* Leads a team that provides operational expertise in contracted services while providing hands-on execution management of operations.
* Manages the client and community relationships at the location, continually assessing operations, and developing plans to provide optimal service and drive employee and customer satisfaction.
* Builds, develops, and leads a management team and staff capable of carrying out organizational objectives.
* Recommends methods, resources, and implementation for service improvement and growth based on understanding of operational needs, capabilities, & contractual obligations.
* In partnership with Finance, manages a budget and assists in the design of improvements to optimize financial performance and operational productivity.
* Manages compliance with all local, state and federal regulations and codes and maintains all associated records and reports.
* Ensures compliance with Aramark's standards of operation including safety standards and Aramark's Business Conduct Policy at all times.

**Qualifications**
------------------

In order to be prepared for this leadership role, qualified candidates will possess:

* Bachelor's degree level education highly preferred in an area of Food Service, Hospitality, Facilities, or Business Management.
* The ability to focus on client and customer services, entrepreneurship and building and growing a strong business is essential to success in this role.
* Savvy interpersonal skills to communicate effectively with clients, senior management, and Aramark support staff.
* Comfortable reading, understanding, and implementing contractual requirements, including identifying opportunities within contract terms and conditions to address operational issues.
* Meaningful experience in service industry, contract services, or hospitality environment.
* Proven ability leading through other managers.
* Experience in creating and managing a department budget, financial controls and analysis.
* Experience crafting product sales strategies and implementing operational programs and initiatives.

This role may have physical demands including, but not limited to, lifting, bending, pushing, pulling and/or extended walking and standing. This role may also require uniforms and/or usage of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).

new_jobs.title: Client Success Engineer
new_jobs.description:
**About Rebar**
---------------

Construction is a $2 trillion industry in the US alone. Most of it still runs like it’s 1995: PDFs, spreadsheets, and email.

Every commercial building starts the same way. Someone opens a few hundred pages of blueprints and counts every piece of equipment, duct, and pipe by hand. Then they price it, bid it, and chase it for months. That work decides who builds what, and for how much. It has barely changed in 30 years.

Rebar is building the AI platform the trades run on. Our models read blueprints the way a veteran in the trades does. Our agents then do the work that follows: counting the job, pricing it, managing the bid, and tracking it through to the order. Counts that took three days now take one. Customers spend hours a day in Rebar, and thousands of new plan sets flow through it every week.

We started with HVAC contractors and their suppliers. Every other trade comes next.

Here’s where we go: when a building goes up, the trades that build it run on Rebar. Agents win the job, run the job, and buy the equipment.

We’re about 50 people in Union Square, growing fast, and backed by top investors. We’ve built only a fraction of what we need to.

**About the Engineering Org**
-----------------------------

The role of the engineer is rapidly changing. We're aware, and we're being intentional about adapting with it. We are fostering an engineering culture of growth and development. We strongly emphasize care of craft and winning together. Our core values are:

* Everyone operates like an owner
* Find a way
* We win together

That being said, the whole company still works really hard! This is something that you should read and internalize. This might not be the place for everyone.

**About the Role**
------------------

We're hiring a software engineer to be the technical arm of our Client Success and Implementation teams.

As we sign bigger customers, every deployment comes with more technical work attached. A contractor wants their historical projects loaded in. Another wants our analytics piped into their ERP or BI tool. Another needs an API change, so their internal systems can pull takeoff data. Today, that work lands on the core engineering team as one-off requests, pulling them off the roadmap. We want one engineer who owns it.

You will still sit in the engineering org and have strong mentorship and learning. You'll come to engineering stand-ups, ship through our normal review process, and attend retros. Your priorities come from our customers.

You can think about this role almost as a forward-deployed engineer. You'll be on calls with customers, figuring out what they actually need and then building it. You’ll get to work with messy data, API integrations, and customer expansion.

We understand the challenges and sacrifices that come with joining an early-stage startup, and we want to emphasize that we're committed to ensuring you leave as a better, more experienced engineer and leader than when you joined. Here you'll own a hard piece of client-side engineering, and watch it scale from hundreds to thousands of users.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Own customer data work
* Build and maintain integrations
* Handle customer API requests
* Scope technical requirements with customers
* Be the escalation path for technical issues
* Turn one-offs into product

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

We want an engineer who likes talking to customers. You should be able to sit on a call with an estimator, understand how their team works, and then go write the script that fixes their problem. You'll be working with messy real-world data, so you should enjoy digging into it and not be scared of a 50,000-row CSV with inconsistent columns.

We are looking for engineers with good judgment, an inquisitive attitude, and the maturity to represent engineering in front of a customer.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* 2+ years of software engineering experience, or a technical client-facing role (solutions engineer, implementation engineer, forward deployed engineer) where you wrote real code
* Strong Python for scripting and data work
* Comfortable with SQL and relational databases (we're on Postgres)
* Experience working with REST APIs, JSON, and webhooks
* Comfortable talking directly with customers, from end users to technical stakeholders
* Writes things down. Your integrations and scripts should be documented well enough that someone else can run them.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Familiarity with TypeScript and React
* Experience with AWS (Lambda, S3, DynamoDB)
* Experience with GraphQL
* Experience with integration platforms or unified APIs (e.g., Merge)
* Background in construction, HVAC/mechanical, or another legacy industry
* Familiarity with estimating, takeoff, ERP, or project management tools used in construction
* Worked at an early-stage or high-growth startup

**Compensation and Benefits**
-----------------------------

* **Salary**: Competitive base salary
* **Equity**: Meaningful equity package, commensurate with experience
* **Benefits**: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
* **Perks**:

  + Agentic tooling budget
  + Lunches provided, dinners provided (after a set time)
  + Great culture in a high-energy office

This is a full-time, on-site role in NYC’s Flatiron District, steps from Madison Square Park and Union Square.

Occasional travel for on-site customer visits.

*Equal Opportunity*

*Rebar is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every background and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.*

Compensation Range: $120K - $165K

Discover Your Career at Emory University: Emory University is a leading research university that fosters excellence and attracts world-class talent to innovate today and prepare leaders for the future. We welcome candidates who can contribute to the excellence of our academic community. Description:

Program Coordinator, OUE Accommodated Testing Services

This is a 9-month position (August – May)

**Emory College of Arts and Sciences** (Emory College), founded in 1836, is Emory University’s primary undergraduate division with more than 5,700 students. Its intensive liberal arts curriculum is backed by all the resources of one of the world's top research universities. Emory College plays a critical role in supporting and expanding the liberal arts throughout the University and its nine

undergraduate and professional schools. This effort is led by the College’s renowned 550-member faculty who bring their path-breaking research – and commitment to excellent teaching – to the classroom. With more than 50 departments and programs, 86 majors, and 63 minors, Emory College students pursue rigorous courses of study that emphasize critical thinking, the nature of evidence from multiple perspectives and the ability to effectively reason and communicate. Emory College students are encouraged – and expected – to ask bold questions and expand the boundaries of knowledge.

The **Office for Undergraduate Education (OUE)** stewards the academic experience of undergraduates in Emory College. It promotes academic excellence by providing leadership and support across the College, both curricular and co-curricular. The OUE advances the vision of Emory College by collaborating with its faculty and Emory University partners to deliver a transformative liberal arts education. In this endeavor, it co-creates academic experiences that enable each Emory College student to reach their full potential and contribute meaningfully to Emory University’s mission to “create, preserve, teach and apply knowledge in the service of humanity.”

OUE Accommodated Testing Service (ACTS) offers in-person, proctored exams for undergraduate students in Emory College courses with Department of Accessibility Services (DAS) accommodations. OUE ACTS facilitates thousands of exams annually and plays a critical role in supporting equitable access to assessment for undergraduate students. This full-time, 9-month position is housed in the Office for Undergraduate Education as part of the Academic Affairs and Faculty Partnerships team.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

* Develops work plans to accomplish program goals and objectives and monitors progress toward their achievement.
* Conducts research and gathers information to develop various publications.
* Develops promotional materials which may include content for reports, briefings, newsletters, grants or other written information related to the program.
* Assists in developing and coordinating program-related conferences, conventions, or meetings.
* Monitors expenditures and may participate in the budget planning process and prepare financial reports.
* May assist in identifying funding resources and developing fund-raising strategies and initiatives.
* Prepares operational and statistical reports.
* Conducts training, represents the program at meetings and conferences, and networks with affiliated groups. May supervise assigned project staff, interns and/or volunteers.
* Performs related responsibilities as required.

**ABOUT GREYSTAR**

Greystar is a leading, fully integrated global real estate platform offering expertise in property management, investment management, development, and construction services in institutional-quality rental housing. Headquartered in Charleston, South Carolina, Greystar manages and operates over $350 billion of real estate in more than 260 markets globally with offices throughout North America, Europe, South America, and the Asia-Pacific region. Greystar is the largest operator of apartments in the United States, managing over one million units/beds globally. Across its platforms, Greystar has nearly $79 billion of assets under management, including over $34 billion of development assets and over $36.5 billion of regulatory assets under management. **JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY**

This role supports and assists the Community Manager in overseeing and managing the financial and operational facets of the community by completing accounting and bookkeeping tasks, preparing monthly close-out and financial reports, processing invoices for payment, collecting rent, fees, and other payments, completing bank deposits, dispositions, and account reconciliations, and using the property management software to record, track, and report on all financial workings of the community.

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Stage: Stabilized**

* Promotes resident satisfaction and retention by responding to complaints, questions, and requests in a timely manner, and taking appropriate action to resolve and address service issues.

-------------------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Management, Communications, or related field from an accredited college or university is preferred.
* 1-3 years minimum of relevant experience in residence life and/or property management that demonstrates the application of community management, sales, marketing, and customer service background sufficient to assist in managing the day-to-day operations of an apartment community, resolve customer complaints and issues, complete financial records, documents, and reports, increase sales revenues, and coordinate the work of a team.
* Understanding of lease terms and lease enforcement, including collections.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Detail-oriented and self-motivated with the ability to work independently and as a collaborative member of a team.

**SPECIALIZED SKILLS:**
-----------------------

* Incumbents must have all licenses and/or certifications as required by State and Local jurisdictions.
* Incumbents must have valid driver’s license to drive a golf cart on property.
* Demonstrated proficiency in Internet, word processing, spreadsheet, and database management programs in order to complete required reports and documents.

new_jobs.title: Sales Development Representative (Inside Sales)
new_jobs.description:
**Sales Development Representative (Inside Sales) - Chicago, IL**

**\*Must live in Chicago, IL or surrounding area\***

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

We are looking for a driven, curious, and resilient Sales Development Representative to join our Inside Sales Team. This is not a holding pattern role; it is the first chapter of a clearly defined career in sales.

As an SDR, you will be responsible for generating qualified meetings through a mix of outbound prospecting and inbound lead qualification. You will work closely with your field sales counterparts to hand off those meetings, ensuring every introduction is well-briefed, timely, and set up to convert.

This role is also the foundation of your sales career. The skills, commercial instincts, and client relationships you build here are what will prepare you for promotion to Business Development Manager within 6 to 12 months, where you will own the full sales cycle from first conversation to close.

This role is built on two foundations. First, execution: showing up, doing the work, and consistently delivering output. Second, growth: developing the judgment, curiosity, and persuasion skills that turn a good SDR into a great closer.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

**Pipeline generation**

* Execute high-volume outbound prospecting via phone, email, and other tools to identify and engage potential clients

* Qualify inbound leads using a structured framework, assessing fit, urgency, and decision-making authority

* Book qualified meetings and hand them off to a BDM with a thorough, well-prepared brief

* Consistently meet or exceed weekly and monthly activity and meeting targets

**Client engagement**

* Research target accounts before outreach, understand their business, hiring challenges, and the commercial impact of those challenges

* Ask enough of the right questions during outreach to qualify the opportunity and set your BDM up for a strong first conversation

* Handle common objections confidently and credibly, influencing rather than scripting your way through conversations

* Follow up on the outcomes of your handoffs, stay curious about what happens after the meeting is booked and use it to sharpen your approach

**Collaboration**

* Work closely with your BDM counterparts, providing thorough meeting briefs and acting as a reliable first point of contact for new prospects

* Keep Salesforce records accurate and up to date, logging all activity and tracking pipeline stages

* Participate in call reviews, coaching sessions, and team huddles, rapidly applying feedback to improve your approach

* Contribute to a culture of high activity, honest feedback, and shared accountability

**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

We hire for two things: the ability to execute today, and the potential to grow into a future closer. You do not need to have worked in staffing before. You do need to be the kind of person who finds a way to get things done.

**Execution — you deliver consistent output and pipeline**

Grit / Resilience

You sustain performance through rejection. A tough week doesn’t derail you — it sharpens your focus.

Activity Capacity

You are comfortable with high-volume outreach and bring structure and energy to every day.

Work Ethic / Discipline

You manage your own time, set your own targets, and don’t need close supervision to stay on track.

Coachability

You take feedback fast and apply it faster. You see coaching as a competitive advantage, not a criticism.

**Growth — you have the potential to become a future BDM**

Business Acumen

You connect hiring challenges to business impact. You ask why, not just what.

Discovery Depth

You ask the question behind the question. You don’t surface needs — you uncover them.

Ownership Mindset

You think beyond the meeting. You care about outcomes, not just activity.

Deal Curiosity

You want to know what happens after the handoff. You use those lessons to get better.

Persuasion Skills

You influence rather than script. You adapt to the person in front of you.

Internal Selling

You collaborate well. You know that winning externally starts with alignment internally.

**EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS**

**Required**

* A genuine interest in sales and a clear desire to build a career as a closer

* Strong verbal and written communication skills, you can hold a conversation and write a compelling email

* A track record of hitting targets or goals in any context: work, academics, sport, or otherwise

* The ability to handle rejection and keep going without losing energy or professionalism

* Comfort with technology, CRM tools, LinkedIn and email sequencing platforms

**Nice to have**

* Prior experience in a sales, customer-facing, or high-volume outreach role

* Exposure to the staffing, recruiting, or workforce solutions industry

* Experience using Salesforce and sales enablement platforms

* A degree in business, communications, or a related field, though we care more about drive than credentials

  

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

In your first 30 days, you will have completed onboarding, learned our solutions and client base, started your first outreach cadences, and booked your first qualified meetings.

By 90 days, you will be consistently hitting your meeting targets, running discovery calls with support, and actively contributing to pipeline. Your CRM will be clean, your activity levels high, and your feedback loops fast.

By 6 to 12 months, you will have demonstrated readiness to progress to Business Development Manager, running your own full-cycle deals, contributing to closed placements, and showing the commercial judgment and client relationships that a BDM role requires.

**CAREER PROGRESSION**

This role is the entry point to a structured sales career at our business. Promotion to Business Development Manager is performance-based, not tenure-based. SDRs who demonstrate the right competencies and hit the right thresholds can progress in as little as six months.

As a BDM, you will own the full sales cycle,

* Prepare analytics, dashboards, and PowerPoint presentations related to fuel cost, inventory, supplier pricing, logistics performance, and operational activity.

* Maintain confidentiality of company pricing, supply, logistics, and financial information.

**Schedule Requirements**  
Monday through Friday, in-office, from **1pm to 10p.m.** with some remote working from home optionality. This position also requires participation in nightly supply sourcing rotation. Weekend rotation managing Road Ranger fuels inventory, delivery forecasting, order creation and delivery amendments, and on call for supply issues and common carrier support,  
**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, Supply Chain, Operations Management, Logistics, or a related field preferred.
* Minimum of 3 to 5 years of experience in supply chain, logistics, transportation, fuel supply, or related operations.
* Experience in general accounting, financial reporting, reconciliation, and business analysis in a corporate environment preferred.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Ability to work under pressure, prioritize tasks, and manage multiple competing deadlines.

* Strong PowerPoint slide creation skills, including executive-level and board-level presentation development.
* Strong data analytics skills, including excel analysis, Power BI, dashboards, reporting, and trend analysis.
* Comfortable presenting analytics, findings, and recommendations to leadership and board-level audiences.
* Proficient creating, utilizing, analyzing spread sheets, pivot tables V look up, databases, reporting tools, and presentation software effectively.
* Flexible, process-oriented, and able to identify opportunities for operational improvement.
